Data Platform Engineer - BI & Integration (all genders)

Vollzeit | Wallern an der Trattnach

INTRO

Als Data Engineer konzipieren und entwickeln Sie bei uns die Datenlandschaft von morgen. Sie verbinden bestehende Systeme mit neuen Lösungen, definieren zentrale Schnittstellen und schaffen skalierbare, zukunftssichere Strukturen. Wenn Sie komplexe Systemlandschaften verstehen und gerne in klaren, tragfähigen Konzepten denken, sind Sie bei uns genau richtig.

AUFGABEN

• Konzeption, Aufbau und Betrieb von Schnittstellen zwischen operativen Systemen und Data-Warehouse Integration neuer Systeme in die bestehende Datenarchitektur

• Mitwirkung beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung des Data Warehouse

• Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Power BI Reports und Dashboards

• Sicherstellung einer konsistenten und standardisierten Reporting-Landschaft

• Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Metadaten, Data Lineage und Datenqualität

• Ableitung von Datenanforderungen aus Geschäftsprozessen und Use Cases

• Übersetzung von Business-Anforderungen in technische Lösungen

QUALIFIKATIONEN

• Studium oder mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung

• Erfahrung im Bereich Datenintegration / Schnittstellenmanagement (z. B. ETL/ELT, Datenflüsse zwischen Systemen)

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Datenverarbeitung

• Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen (APIs, Datenimporte, Systemintegration)

• Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Lobster / Data Warehouse / Plattformen, BI-Tools (Power BI, etc.)

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Umsetzungsstärke

WAS BIETEN WIR?

UNSERE BENEFITS

Aus- und Weiterbildung

Wir fördern persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. Ziele und Kurse werden jährlich abgestimmt, ob intern oder extern - Weiterbildung ist bei uns garantiert. Keep on learning!

 Choose your Hours

 Home-Office

Je nach Tätigkeit kann an bestimmten Tagen von zu Hause gearbeitet werden. Alle relevanten Infos zur Home-Office-Regelung werden beim Arbeitsbeginn erläutert.

 Easy Work

Je nach Position und Tätigkeit bekommen unsere Mitarbeitenden natürlich alles, was zum Arbeiten nötig ist: von sicherer Arbeitskleidung über Laptops bis hin zum Auto.

Egal ob auf Baustellen oder im Büro, wir fördern gemeinsame Veranstaltungen und Teambuilding-Aktivitäten, wie Skitage, Sommerfeste und Weihnachtsfeiern, um den Teamgeist zu stärken und unsere „Lasting Connections" zu schaffen.

description_full:
Senior Software Engineer - Data (Python, AWS)

Vienna

We're the world's leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.

ABOUT US:

 The Ads Analytics team is the backbone of our advertising intelligence platform, processing terabytes of data daily from programmatic, social, and search advertising channels. We build end-to-end solutions that transform raw advertising data into actionable business insights and leverage rich analytics data to create sophisticated sport audience segments.

THE CHALLENGE

We're scaling rapidly and need a senior data engineer who can take ownership of complex, multi-faceted data projects. You'll be tackling challenges like:

• Scale & Performance Engineering: Processing and analyzing terabytes of advertising data with sub-second query performance while building and maintaining robust ETL pipelines using Spark and AWS services to handle massive data volumes daily

• Data Pipeline Architecture & Development: Designing and building scalable data processing systems, developing backend APIs and microservices (Python or Go), architecting data flows that support both batch and real-time analytics requirements, and managing user-facing dashboards that visualize complex data insights

• Infrastructure & Data Quality Operations: Implementing robust monitoring and alerting systems to detect data quality issues, managing AWS infrastructure using Terraform, implementing CI/CD best practices, and maintaining high coding standards across data processing systems

• Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration: Leading large-scale data projects from requirements gathering through delivery, bridging technical implementation with business requirements, mentoring team members, and presenting technical concepts to stakeholders while challenging requirements constructively

• End-to-End Data System Ownership: Taking complete ownership of complex data engineering projects while ensuring high availability and accuracy for both internal stakeholders and external clients, championing clean code principles, and serving as a knowledge leader who supports delivering the right data solutions

ABOUT YOU

• 5+ years of data engineering experience with proven track record of leading complex data projects from conception to delivery

• Exceptional communication skills and experience working in cross-functional teams with analysts, product managers, and business stakeholders

• AWS & Data Engineering: Very strong hands-on experience with AWS services (S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, EMR, etc.) and proficiency with Apache Spark for large-scale data processing

• Backend Development: Strong experience with Python for building data processing services and APIs, plus expert-level SQL for data processing and analytics

• Infrastructure & DevOps: Hands-on experience with Docker, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines with automation best practices for data systems

• Clean Code Advocate: Strong commitment to writing clean, maintainable, well-documented code with comprehensive testing and deep knowledge of analytics/reporting requirements

• Data Architecture: Experience designing scalable data architectures, data modeling, and optimizing data processing workflows

• Dashboard Development: Experience creating and managing analytics dashboards in bi tools (Tableau, Qlik Sense, Quicksuite, Power BI) and data visualization solutions to present complex insights to stakeholders

• GenAI Tools (beneficial): Experience working with contextual and prompt engineering with GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar AI assistants

OUR OFFER:

•

A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and US)

•

Ability to shape your own workday and career via a clearly defined professional and personal development plan

•

Opportunity to work with senior leadership, develop yourself and build your career within an inspiring and fast-growing company and digital sports environment.

•

A vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants

•

A company culture that promotes social aspects, sports, physical exercise and fun.

•

Innovative and cross-team challenges like ShipIt, office sports tournaments in Darts and Table Tennis and unique beer brewing competitions.

•

Competitive salary and benefits (e.g. retirement pension and insurance plan)

•

Sportradar takes over the full costs of EUR 365.- for the Öffi-Ticket (Jahreskarte) for you

OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

•

Initial Screening: A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations.

•

Technical: Theoretical Interview: 60 minutes to discuss your technical skills on the theoretical level with the technical team.

•

Technical: Coding Interview: 60 minutes of live coding where we do not access the end result but rather the candidate's approach (clean code and thinking process).

•

System Design Interview: 60 minutes to solve a high-level problem with certain requirements.

•

Final Steps: Receive final feedback while onsite visit might be requested and, if successful, an offer!

The minimum monthly salary for this position is according to the Collective Bargaining Agreement. Overpayment will be considered depending on qualifications and working experience.

At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) - we believe skills evolve over time. If you're willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

• Configuration and Change Management: Assist in maintaining product configurations, baselines, and configuration records to ensure project data remains accurate and up to date

• Requirements Management: Support the documentation, organization, and traceability of requirements throughout the development process

• Documentation and Quality Compliance: Review and maintain project documents while ensuring compliance with internal procedures and relevant quality standards

• Tool Administration and User Support: Provide support for engineering tools such as Windchill, JIRA, and JAMA, helping users with basic tool-related activities

• Reporting and Project Support: Prepare traceability and coverage reports and support project teams with configuration and documentation-related tasks

• Process Improvement and Automation: Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and assist in developing simple scripts or automation solutions for routine activities

Further Information
 Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
 Duration: min. 18 months

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

• Education: Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field

• Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Attention to Detail: Structured and detail-oriented working style with a focus on accuracy and quality

• Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively and work independently

• Technical Skills: Basic understanding of semiconductor development, knowledge of automotive development processes, ISO 26262, or requirements and configuration management is a plus, familiarity with engineering and project management tools such as JIRA, JAMA, or SVN is an advantage, basic programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python or similar) are beneficial and support process automation activities

• Language Skills: Fluent in English, German language skills are considered a plus

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

• Highest completed educational certificate (Matura certificate for Bachelor students, Bachelor certificate for Master students)

• Reference letter (optional)

description_full:
AI Governance Technical Specialist (w/m/d)

Als eine der führenden Versicherungen wissen wir, dass wir gemeinsam mehr bewegen können. Bei UNIQA sind wir deshalb die Gemeinschaft für ein besseres Leben. Wir nutzen unsere individuellen Fähigkeiten, um zusammen eine bessere Zukunft zu gestalten. Erzähle uns von deinen Stärken und bewirb dich als AI Governance Technical Specialist (w/m/d)

Wir, das Team Group Data & AI, sind eine Gruppe von motivierten, kreativen und innovativen Daten- & AI-Enthusiast:innen mit Expertise in verschiedenen Themengebieten. Unser Ziel ist es UNIQA fit für die digitale Transformation zu machen.
 Wir inspirieren unsere Kolleg:innen in dem wir gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen an innovativen Datenlösungen arbeiten und diese auch umsetzen. Gleichzeitig formen wir mit Standards und Guidelines verbindliche Vorgaben und Best Practices zum korrekten Umgang mit Daten und AI im Konzern.

Bist du neugierig zu sehen, wie sich erfolgreicher Einsatz von KI mit der Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Vorgaben verbinden lässt? Dann gestalte bei uns aktiv mit, wie wir AI Governance im Konzern etablieren und weiterentwickeln. Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass wir das Potenzial von KI rechtskonform, sicher und verantwortungsvoll nutzen können.

Das erwartet dich:

• Du bist Teil eines agilen Teams, das Innovationen für die UNIQA Gruppe vorantreibt und dabei die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicherstellt. Unser Ziel ist es, Innovation durch Daten und KI zu fördern und gleichzeitig compliant zu bleiben

• Du entwickelst die Data- und AI-Governance auf Basis des EU AI Act sowie weiterer relevanter regulatorischer Anforderungen kontinuierlich weiter

• Du führst Assessments von KI-Lösungen und KI-Anwendungsfällen mit Fokus auf SaaS-Lösungen hinsichtlich der Einhaltung des EU AI Act, interner Richtlinien sowie Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsanforderungen durch

• Du definierst und pflegst den konzernweiten AI Tool Stack, einschließlich Modellen, Plattformen und KI-Services, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Data Protection, Procurement und Legal

• Gemeinsam mit dem Governance Lead gestaltest du notwendige Anpassungen interner Richtlinien für die UNIQA Gruppe

• Du berätst Fachbereiche, IT-Teams und das Management zu AI-Governance-, Risiko- und regulatorischen Fragestellungen

Das bringst du mit:

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen AI Governance, IT Audit, Technology Risk, Internal Audit, Compliance, Informationssicherheit oder Beratung

• Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Ausbildung mit technischem Schwerpunkt, z. B. Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, AI/ML, Software Engineering oder IT Security

• Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis moderner KI-Technologien wie Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), cloudbasierter AI-Services und moderner Softwarearchitekturen

• Die Fähigkeit, technische Konzepte, Systemarchitekturen und KI-Lösungen hinsichtlich regulatorischer, sicherheitsbezogener und governance-relevanter Anforderungen zu bewerten und verständlich aufzubereiten

• Kenntnisse relevanter regulatorischer Rahmenwerke wie EU AI Act, DSGVO, DORA, NIS2 und Outsourcing-Anforderungen

• Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Audits, Kontrollprüfungen oder Governance Assessments

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Kompetenzen sowie die Fähigkeit, regulatorische, fachliche und technische Anforderungen miteinander zu verbinden

• Eine strukturierte, zielorientierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Du passt zu uns, wenn du:

• Visionen und Ziele vermittelst und Andere damit begeistern kannst

• gerne Verantwortung übernimmst

• Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Menschen hast

• einfache und realisierbare Lösungen findest

Wir bei UNIQA leben Vielfalt. Wir setzen auf unterschiedliche Perspektiven in unseren Teams und Führungspositionen. Daher freuen wir uns sehr über Bewerbungen, die unsere Vielfalt bereichern.

 Du bist dir nicht sicher, ob dein Profil unseren Anforderungen entspricht? Bewirb dich trotzdem! UNIQA sucht nach Kandidat:innen mit Ambition, Mut zur Veränderung und Begeisterungsfähigkeit!

description_full:
Trainee (m/f/d) - ID 22307en_US

Graz

Every day, ANDRITZ continues to deliver successful innovative solutions to our customers globally. Why are we so successful? Because we are passionate and love what we do! We are at the forefront of future engineering technologies, with solutions that ensure the success of our clients in key industries that are shaping the future of the world we live in.

We offer a 3-month Internship in our Supply Chain Team in Graz - including the opportunity for an ongoing minor employment.

About the Position

We are looking for a highly motivated intern to support our Supply Chain Management Austria team in driving digital transformation, process excellence, and data-driven decision-making.
 This role offers hands-on experience in analyzing supply chain processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and implementing innovative solutions using Celonis, Artificial Intelligence, and automation technologies.
 You will work directly with experienced supply chain professionals and contribute to real business improvement projects with measurable impact.

Your Tasks

• Support data analytics initiatives within the Operational Excellence Team in Supply Chain Management Austria.

• Analyze procurement and supply chain processes using Celonis and process mining methodologies.

• Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities across purchasing and operational processes.

• Conduct value stream analyses and support continuous improvement initiatives.

• Develop dashboards, reports, and performance indicators to increase process transparency.

• Apply AI-based tools and analytics to optimize workflows and support decision-making.

• Participate in automation projects for procurement and supply chain processes.

• Support the implementation of digital solutions and process standardization initiatives.

• Collaborate with stakeholders across Procurement, Logistics, Quality, and Operational Excellence.

• Prepare management presentations, analyses, and recommendations for improvement projects.

• Contribute to strategic initiatives focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and digital transformation.

Your Profile

• Ongoing studies in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Strong analytical thinking and interest in data-driven process optimization.

• Affinity for digital technologies, AI applications, and automation.

• Practical experience gained through internships, university projects, research activities, or student jobs in data analytics, process improvement, supply chain management, procurement, operational excellence, or digital transformation is highly desirable.

• First experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, Celonis, or similar is advantageous.

• Initial hands-on experience with process mining, automation, business intelligence, machine learning, AI applications, or continuous improvement projects is considered a strong advantage.

• Interest in supply chain management, procurement, and operational excellence.

• Structured, independent, and solution-oriented working style.

• Strong communication and teamwork skills.

• Good English skills; German is an advantage.

What We Offer

• Direct involvement in strategic digitalization and AI initiatives.

• Practical experience with Celonis Process Mining, AI applications, and procurement process automation.

• Opportunity to work on real supply chain improvement projects with measurable business impact.

• Collaboration with senior supply chain and operational excellence experts.

• Dynamic international environment within a leading industrial company.

• Possibility of continuing employment on a part-time basis after successful completion of the internship.

• Flexible working hours compatible with your studies.

• Various employee discounts

• Subsidized company restaurant

• Parking spaces & public accessibility

In Austria we are legally obliged to announce at least a gross monthly salary of EUR 2.568,80 for this position. Depending on qualifications and professional experience we offer you a market-based salary.

title: Software Project Manager Railway Systems (f/m/d)

Hitachi in Austria is a full system provider and global supplier of train control technology and traffic management systems (e.g. European Train Control System (ETCS), Electronic interlockings, Operation Control Centers and dispatching systems, field elements).

The route control product development team focuses on middleware layer building blocks like run-time execution environment, redundancy management, communication protocol stacks, boot/download procedures and diagnosis, which close the gap between operating system services and railway specific business logic.

As part of the route control product development team you are responsible for the technical project management of the development and integration of these components for new versions of the interlocking system product line. Join us now at Hitachi Rail Austria!

SOFTWARE PROJECT MANAGER RAILWAY SYSTEMS (F/M/D)

• Communication and reporting of status and critical issues in a short and concise format

• Working in an international team and in cooperation with other business line units

• Knowledge of safety critical systems or experience in railway domain is an advantage

description_full:
Data Platform Engineer - BI & Integration

Full-time | Wallern an der Trattnach

INTRO

As a Data Engineer, you design and develop the data landscape of tomorrow with us. You connect existing systems with new solutions, define key interfaces, and create scalable, future-proof structures. If you understand complex system landscapes and enjoy thinking in clear, sustainable concepts, you are exactly right with us.

TASKS

• Design, development, and operation of interfaces between operational systems and the data warehouse, as well as the integration of new systems into the existing data architecture

• Contribution to the development and ongoing enhancement of the data warehouse

• Development and ongoing enhancement of Power BI reports and dashboards

• Ensuring a consistent and standardized reporting landscape, as well as the maintenance and further development of metadata, data lineage, and data quality

• Derivation of data requirements from business processes and use cases, and translation of business requirements into technical solutions

QUALIFICATIONS

• University degree or at least 5 years of professional experience

• Experience in the field of data integration / interface management (e.g., ETL/ELT, data flows between systems)

• Very strong knowledge of SQL and data processing

• Experience with interfaces (APIs, data imports, system integration)

• Ideally, experience with Lobster, data warehouse/platforms, and BI tools (e.g., Power BI)

• High level of personal responsibility and strong execution skills

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

OUR BENEFITS

Choose your Hours

In office jobs, we use flexitime to create space for your family, studies, or hobbies. We also strive for flexibility for our teams on construction sites. Wherever possible, working hours are agreed individually with the manager and the team.

 Education and training

We support your personal and professional development. Goals and courses are coordinated annually, whether internally or externally - your further training is guaranteed with us. Keep on learning!

 Home office

Depending on your job, you can work from home on certain days. You will receive all relevant information on the home office regulations when you start work.

 Easy work

Depending on the position and activity, every employee naturally receives everything they need to work with us: from safe work clothes to laptops and cars.

 Works council

Our works council offers additional benefits such as allowances, discounts at partner companies, company future security and small gifts on special occasions.

 Welcome on board

We attach great importance to personal onboarding. New colleagues receive comprehensive training, a tour and a job-related introduction on their first day at work. We want our new heroes to feel part of the family straight away.

 Company doctor

Our company doctor regularly visits the sites, checks workstations for ergonomics and offers free vaccinations such as TBE or influenza.

 Bring a friend

Employee referrals are important to us. We offer a generous bonus for the successful placement of new colleagues who share our values.

 Have some fun

Whether on construction sites or in the office, we promote joint events and team-building activities, such as ski days, summer parties and Christmas parties, to strengthen team spirit and create our "Lasting Connections".

 Easy arrival

Our main location in Wallern is ideally situated, with fast connections and traffic jam-free accessibility, making your commute stress-free. There are also plenty of parking spaces available at our locations.

 Save some money

Each location offers its employees special discounts from our partner companies. You can find out exactly where in your welcome folder.

 Sport & movement

Our employees keep fit with daily breaks, group courses and participation in sporting events. These offers are free of charge and promote team spirit.

 Eat & Drink

Of course, we have fruit, coffee, and tea for you at all locations. Additionally, there is a lunch allowance.

 Care for kids

In Wallern, we offer free childcare in the summer to bridge the time for our Zauner kids.

 The "we" counts

Building a team means more than combining skills. At Zauner, we see the whole person, creating genuine cohesion. We value everyone equally, regardless of age, gender, origin or sexual orientation. That's why we live the you. Together, we achieve more

 Company bicycle

Under certain conditions, you can lease a bike to be environmentally friendly and promote your health at the same time.

 Open-door culture

Our doors are always open. For us, transparency and openness are the basis for a trusting relationship.

SALARY

Please note that the collectively agreed minimum salary under the attractive collective agreement for the metal industry is EUR3,109.21 gross per month. The actual salary ranges between EUR3,500.00 and EUR4,500.00 gross and will be determined jointly with you depending on your qualifications and experience.

Become part of the Zaunergroup

ANSPRECHPARTNER:IN

Personal contact is particularly important to us at Zaunergroup. Even more when it comes to new colleagues. Here you will find the right contact person for your application and, of course, for any questions you may have. We look forward to hearing from you.

Johanna Pühringer-Mariacher

description_full:
Software Integration Engineer (all genders)

• Wolfholzgasse, 2345, Brunn am Gebirge, Niederösterreich, Austria

• Full-time

Company Description

At IMS Nanofabrication, we shape the future -- one nanometer at a time. Headquartered in Austria, with subsidiaries in Vienna, Taiwan, South Korea, and the USA, we are a global leader in semiconductor technology. Our cutting-edge mask writers power the world's most advanced chip manufacturing, making high-performance smartphones, PCs, and data centers possible. By pushing the boundaries of nanofabrication, we enable innovation at the smallest scale -- driving progress on a global level.

Job Description

Are you passionate about cutting-edge semiconductor technology and want to work in an environment where software meets hardware at the highest level? As part of our software support team at IMS, you will be responsible for deploying and integrating our multi-beam mask writer software in high-tech fabrication plants around the world -- directly at the sites of the world's leading chip manufacturers. You will continuously support the automation and optimization of these tasks, drive project ownership, and contribute to improving our tools and processes. If you thrive in hands-on, international environments and enjoy solving complex technical challenges, we want to hear from you.

Your responsibilities:

• Deploy and integrate our multi-beam mask writer software at IMS and on customer sites

• Prepare tool-specific configurations and perform regular software and configuration upgrades on customer and IMS tools and testbenches

• Conduct FAT (factory acceptance tests) including full documentation

• Troubleshoot issues by analyzing data, identifying root causes, and proposing solutions

• Report troubleshooting activities, observations, test outcomes, and proposed solutions via Jira ticketing system

• Provide expert support to onsite engineers

• Drive ongoing improvement, automation, and optimization of team tasks

• Collaborate closely with R&D engineers and other stakeholders to develop best solutions

• Create technical documentation

• Take ownership of projects and work independently

• Fulfill on-call duties (one weekend every two months)

Qualifications

• A technical degree (e.g., computer science, electrical engineering, physics) or at least 3 years of relevant technical experience

• Very good knowledge of Linux-based operating systems (understanding of system architectures)

• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals

• Analytical thinking and the ability to tackle complex challenges

• Resilience and the ability to perform well under pressure

• Flexibility and willingness to travel a few times per year (up to one month per trip)

• A hands-on mentality and customer-oriented thinking

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset

• A proactive approach and the ability to work independently

• Very good spoken and written English

• Willingness to work in a clean room environment

• Git experience is of advantage

• Basic knowledge of Python or other programming languages would be beneficial

• Basic data base skills are also a plus

Additional Information

What you can look forward to:

• Travel: The chance to travel to international branches and customer sites

• Leading Edge & High-Tech: The privilege of working in high-tech fabs at the world's leading chip manufacturers. Gain deep knowledge of our multi-beam mask writer hardware and software architecture through deployments, integration, and troubleshooting.

• Career & Development: Exciting opportunities to grow professionally and personally - in an international environment

• Team Culture: Dynamic, collegial and open to new ideas - together we are writing the future

• Flexibility: Flexible working hours, the option to work from home and workation

• Catering: Subsidized canteen, fresh fruit and drinks right in the office

• Mobility: Shuttle bus for a comfortable journey, free parking spaces, e-charging stations for cars and motorcycles, bicycle parking spaces with e-bike charging station

• Health & well-being: Company doctor and psychologist - support for your health

• Bonus program: All employees benefit from our success - together we achieve more

• Job bike: Environmentally friendly commuting and staying fit - with us you can lease your bike at a reasonable price

• Events & team building: Summer party, business run, cool team events - we celebrate our successes together

• Employee discounts: From car washes to wellness days - benefit from many discounts

With us you will receive an attractive annual gross salary from 50.000,- EUR (plus bonus, KV Metallgewerbe). Depending on your experience, this can also be higher.

No matter where you are from, how you live, what you believe in - we look forward to receiving your application! What counts for us is the person, not the label. That's why we welcome your unique perspective.

We are committed to equal opportunities and want all applications to be assessed with an open mind. You are welcome to remove your personal information such as age, origin etc. from your CV. We don't need a photo either. This way we can concentrate on the essentials: your qualifications and experience!

• Experience with low-code AI agent development (Copilot Studio) and automation tools (Power Automate).

• Strong plus: experience with high-code AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry).

• Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.

• Team spirit and ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries.

description_full:
Scientific Coordinator: Executive Assistance to incoming ERC Vice President

Full Time (40 h/w)

Klosterneuburg near Vienna, Austria / Home Office possible

EUR 56,000* gross/year (excl. overtime), position limited until December 31st, 2028

ISTA is growing. Grow with us!

Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA) is a constantly growing international institute for conducting world-class research in mathematics, computer science, life sciences & physical sciences. We strive to recruit passionate professionals from across the world over all fields who strive to support our goal of excellent research. Located within a beautiful campus on the outskirts of Vienna, we offer multiple opportunities for personal growth in a stable working environment. Get an insight!

Your responsibilities

Help shape frontier research in Europe: Prof. Tom Henzinger is recruiting and seeking support for his role as incoming Vice President of the European Research Council (ERC), where he will be responsible for the Physical Sciences & Engineering domain. In this position you will help enable the ERC's mission to advance investigator-driven frontier research across all fields of research through competitive funding. For the duration of this assignment (2 years), you will work under the instructions of Tom Henzinger at ISTA in close proximity to the Vice-President's office.

• Maintaining membership of ERC evaluation panels: Gather detailed information on prospective panel members (e.g. CVs, publication lists), brief the Vice President, and - following decisions - contact proposed members on his behalf; once candidates accept informally, transmit details to the ERC Executive Agency's (ERCEA) team for formal invitation and contracting

• Interface with the ERCEA and ScC: Serve as the operational link between the Vice President, ERCEA colleagues, Scientific Council (ScC) members and the offices of the other ERC Vice Presidents; facilitate timely information flow with ScC members in the Physical Sciences & Engineering domain

• Preparation for Scientific Council meetings & ERC Board: Coordinate inputs and prepare documents requiring the Vice President's contribution ahead of meetings; ensure materials are complete, accurate and submitted on time

• Support the Vice President: Assist with drafting policy notes, reports and presentations; Support preparing briefings for discussions with external stakeholders; respond to ERC-related enquiries from national contact points and the research community

• External liaison and events: Coordinate and organize events hosted by Tom Henzinger in his ERC VP role; Manage the VP's ERC-related invitations and collaborate with his ISTA administrative assistant on travel planning

Your profile

• Completed PhD in any area of Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Engineering

• Proven experience in research administration (e.g., in grant office/funding agencies, faculty recruiting/affairs)

• Knowledge of research funding mechanisms and policy at national and European levels is an advantage

• Ability to work independently and with low level of supervision combined with excellent organizational skills

• Excellent written English skills, particularly for concise memos, reports and meeting notes

• Excellent spoken English skills and strong interpersonal skills, particularly diplomatic communication with culturally diverse counterparts and scientists on all career levels

• Proven ability to manage multiple complex tasks simultaneously with accuracy and discretion

• Willingness and flexibility to travel within Europe, five times per year for 4-5 days each to Scientific Council meetings, and additional short trips to accompany the Vice President to meetings

• Please note that this position is based in Austria; Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Austria and available to start on December 1, 2026

Apply now

Your benefits

• Education & training

• Cafeteria

• Childcare

• Free shuttle bus

• Multiple health offers

• Pension insurance

⁎ This position comes with possible overpayment depending on education, qualification and work experience. ISTA processes your personal data in accordance with the law. For more information, please refer to ww www.ista.ac.at/data-protection.

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und relationalen Datenbanken

IT Project Manager - Sales Applications

Elsbethen, Österreich

Apply now

To support our ambitious sales roadmap with exciting IT sales projects and new initiatives, we are expanding our Global IT Sales Projects team and are looking for a driven IT Project Manager in the area of sales applications. In this role, you will equip our global sales teams with the tools and "wings" they need to sell smarter, faster, and more effectively. If you're ready to transform ideas into deliverables, projects into success stories, and challenges into opportunities, this is your chance to shine, especially if you bring experience in using AI in projects and implementing it in actual solutions.

As IT Project Manager for Sales Applications, you support cross-functional projects and initiatives for our global sales departments. You'll play a key role in supporting IT projects and initiatives across Global Off-Premise, On-Premise, and Category teams. From enabling smarter decision-making to improving tools and processes, your work will contribute to the success of sales strategies worldwide and enable the sales force to improve its performance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Areas that play to your strengths

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

PROJECT MANAGEMENT

In this role, you lead and deliver large-scale, cross-functional international projects in the area of sales and business applications, with a strong focus on analytics and AI enablement. You coordinate scope, budget, timelines, quality, and external implementation teams or partners, ensuring alignment across all key stakeholders (IT, Sales, Data, etc.). You develop and manage strong relationships with stakeholders in Headquarters IT, the Headquarters sales department, and local subsidiaries, while managing and steering external vendors, implementation partners, and internal delivery teams to ensure successful end-to-end execution.

REQUIREMENTS ENGINEERING & BUSINESS ANALYSIS

You partner closely with IT and sales teams to understand business processes, gather and challenge requirements, and translate them into robust technical concepts for sales-related applications. You lead requirements engineering efforts, question assumptions, and ensure all initiatives are aligned with strategic objectives. Together with IT, data, and analytics teams, you design end-to-end solution architectures, for example, leveraging cloud platforms, data lakes, and AI/ML models. By doing so, you drive the standardization and harmonization of global sales processes through technology and analytics.

INNOVATION & NEW INITIATIVES SUPPORT

You identify and support innovative approaches to improve sales tools and processes, collaborating closely with the innovation team to explore new technologies and opportunities. In addition, you lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives to test, validate, and scale new ideas.

TRANSFORMATION CONSULTING

In this role, you serve as a trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders on digital transformation, analytics strategy, and AI opportunities, identifying high-value use cases for advanced analytics, machine learning, and automation within sales and commercial functions. You conduct impact assessments and feasibility studies and develop business cases for new initiatives while promoting a data-driven mindset and supporting the organization in adopting new tools and ways of working.

Experience

Your areas of knowledge and expertise

That matter most for this role:

• University degree in Computer Science/ Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience

• Fluent English skills, German is a plus

• At least 4 years of experience in the IT environment with a focus on sales, business analysis, and project management, ideally within the FMCG industry

• Strong project management capabilities with a track record of successfully delivering and rolling out business applications (incl. end-to-end solutions)

• Excellent analytical and conceptual thinking skills; able to navigate complex processes and proactively address risks

• Proven exposure to modern data platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks, or cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure), as well as SAP systems such as S/4, CRM, and MDG, is considered a plus

• Ability to work effectively in an international and cross-functional team

• Eagerness to learn and contribute with fresh ideas, paired with a proactive and customer-oriented mindset

• Travel: 0-10 %

Company Description

At IMS Nanofabrication, we shape the future -- one nanometer at a time. Headquartered in Austria, with subsidiaries in Vienna, Taiwan, South Korea, and the USA, we are a global leader in semiconductor technology. Our cutting-edge mask writers power the world's most advanced chip manufacturing, making high-performance smartphones, PCs, and data centers possible. By pushing the boundaries of nanofabrication, we enable innovation at the smallest scale -- driving progress on a global level.

Job Description

Are you passionate about ensuring the quality and reliability of highly complex technical components in a high-tech manufacturing environment? In this leadership role, you will lead our Incoming Inspection team and drive quality assurance activities related to supplied components, assemblies and materials. Working closely with Procurement, Operations, Engineering, Supplier Quality and external partners, you will help ensure that incoming goods consistently meet our demanding quality standards and contribute to the reliable manufacturing of our multi-beam mask writers.

Your Responsibilities

• Lead, develop and empower the Incoming Inspection team while fostering a culture of quality, accountability and continuous improvement

• Define, implement and continuously improve incoming inspection concepts, quality standards and risk-based control plans for supplied components and assemblies

Qualifications

• Experience working closely with Procurement organizations and external suppliers

You'll combine strong coding skills with analytical structure, and you're comfortable balancing engineering tasks with clear, compelling storytelling for business audiences.

You'll understand how to build clean, maintainable data pipelines; you enjoy diving into operational datasets; and you know how to formulate the right analyses to answer our most pressing questions. DELIVER PROJECTS PART OF EXISTING DATA SCIENCE SERVICE LINES

BUILD ROBUST DATA FOUNDATIONS

Not content focusing exclusively on existing service lines and initiatives, you'll actively think along and propose new ways of generating even more value for our stakeholders.

STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

You'll build close relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Thanks to your collaborative attitude and ability to absorb constructive feedback, you will maximise the likelihood of making each and every Data Science initiative a success for the company.

ORGANISATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Wir haben spannende Aufgaben für Ihre Dissertation aus den unterschiedlichsten Fachdisziplinen. Eingebettet in die Fachabteilungen der voestalpine Stahl GmbH können Sie an aktuellen und praxisrelevanten Problemstellungen aus einem breiten Feld von Themengebieten forschen. Die Forschungsfragen umfassen beispielsweise:

• Prozessoptimierung und -implementierung:

• Welche neuen metallurgischen Verfahren unterstützen uns bei der Umsetzung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie?

• Welche Technologien können implementiert werden, um die aktuellen Produktionsprozesse zu verbessern und effizienter zu gestalten?

• Welche neuen Produktionsprozesse sind Basis für die Umsetzung neuer Produktkonzepte?

• Wie können durch Abstimmung von Legierungsdesign und Anlagenparametern neue Stahllegierungen entwickelt werden, die die Anforderungen an die Produkteigenschaften und Nachhaltigkeit noch besser erfüllen?

• Wie können wir mit innovativen Beschichtungssystemen einen Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schaffen?

• Modellbildung und Simulation:

• Wie können durch rechnerische oder physikalische Simulation von Prozessen und Werkstoffen höchste Prozesssicherheit und engste Eigenschaftsbereiche erreicht werden?

• Wie können unsere Produkte mit Simulation der anwendungstechnischen Prozesse auf beste Verarbeitbarkeit bei unseren Kunden getrimmt werden?

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Deloitte Österreich ist der führende Anbieter von Professional Services. Das gelingt uns mit unseren rund 1.900 engagierten Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern an 17 Standorten, die Unternehmen und Institutionen in verschiedenen Bereichen betreuen.

Wir schätzen die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeitenden und sehen sie als essenziellen Schlüssel für Innovation und Erfolg. Deshalb setzen wir uns dafür ein, dass bei uns jede:r die gleichen Chancen erhält.

Stellenbeschreibung

Unser Emerging ERP Solutions Team begleitet Unternehmen bei ERP-Transformationsinitiativen - von der ersten Zieldefinition bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung moderner ERP‑Technologien. Gemeinsam mit Entscheidungsträger:innen entwickeln wir Lösungsdesigns, die digitale Transformationsprogramme sinnvoll unterstützen.

Was dich erwartet:

• Du übernimmst in agilen Projektumfeldern eigenverantwortlich Arbeitspakete und stellst deren fristgerechte sowie qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung sicher.

• Du übernimmst die Konzeption integrierter Prozess- und Systemdesigns im Cloud-ERP-Umfeld für End-to-End-Abläufe wie R2R, O2C oder P2P und präsentierst deine Lösungsansätze überzeugend auf Fach- und Managementebene.

• Nach dem Roll-out unterstützt du Kund:innen dabei, neue Arbeitsweisen nachhaltig zu verankern, Mehrwertpotenziale zu realisieren und die Lösung kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

• Du wirkst bei Angeboten mit und entwickelst vielseitige Proof‑of‑Concepts, Demos sowie Beiträge für Business‑Development‑ und Marketingaktivitäten.

• Du engagierst dich bei der Aus- und Weiterbildung im Team und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg:innen zusammen.

Qualifikationen

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, vorzugsweise mit Schwerpunkt (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Computer Science oder verwandten Bereichen.

• Du hast mindestens drei Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Bereich ERP‑Transformation Consulting - bevorzugt in Workday, Oracle NetSuite, Odoo oder anderen modernen Plattformen.

• Du bringst tiefgehendes Prozessverständnis in Finance, Controlling, Procurement, Supply Chain sowie Sales- und Billing-Prozessen mit und weißt, wie diese im Rahmen einer ERP-Transformation harmonisiert, standardisiert und integriert abgebildet werden.

• Du fühlst dich wohl in dynamischen Beratungs‑ und Transformationsumgebungen und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und verfügst eine Hands-on-Mentalität.

• Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und bist offen für projektbezogene Reisetätigkeiten.

Erfüllst du nicht alle genannten Kriterien? Kein Problem! Uns ist bewusst, dass nicht jede:r alle Anforderungen erfüllen kann, deshalb sind wir bereit, in deine Entwicklung zu investieren.

Zusätzliche Informationen

Jahresbruttogehalt ab EUR 56.000,-  (All In) auf Level Senior Consultant.  Deine Vergütung orientiert sich selbstverständlich an deiner individuellen Qualifikation und positionsrelevanten Berufserfahrung. Darüber hinaus erwarten dich attraktive Zusatzleistungen und Benefits.

Make an impact that matters. Wir ermutigen dich, neue Verantwortungen zu übernehmen, dich aktiv in spannende Projekte einzubringen und wertvolle Erfahrungen zu sammeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir dir exzellente Trainingsprogramme, um deine Karriereziele zu erreichen und dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von starkem Zusammenhalt und unseren gemeinsamen Werten. Dabei ist uns das Wellbeing unserer Mitarbeitenden besonders wichtig. Außerdem bieten wir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit im Home Office oder im Büro im Stadtzentrum zu arbeiten.

description_full:
Vollzeit

Data Scientist - TV-Insight

Elsbethen, Österreich

Apply now

Are you passionate about creating innovative data-driven products that reshape industries?

TV-Insight is an exciting digital spin-off within Red Bull, located in Elsbethen (Austria), dedicated to revolutionizing the TV measurement and advertisement industry. As a Data Scientist, you will be at the forefront of creating and improving the analytical foundation of our novel product, capable of handling multiple millions of classification tasks every second. Working alongside a team of talented data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders, you will play a key role in defining the success of a state-of-the-art analytics product.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Areas that play to your strengths

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

Model Ownership & Production Deployment

You take ownership of the development and deployment of machine learning models for a dedicated TV-Insight market. This includes building and improving real-time machine learning applications as well as developing model components that feed into real-time projection processing. Working closely with a highly specialized team of engineers and data analysts, you ensure a strong understanding of the technical implementation while setting the highest standards for statistical modelling, creating direct business impact from day one.

Exploratory Analysis, Model Understanding & Communication

You conduct thorough exploratory data analyses to evaluate input data and gain a deep understanding of model behaviour and performance. In both research tasks and day-to-day work, you uphold best practices in modelling approaches and production-quality code. You communicate your insights in a clear and accessible way through dashboards and reports, enabling data-driven decision-making for management and key stakeholders.

Continuous Innovation & Technical Excellence

You continuously stay up to date with technological and industry developments to expand your skill set and strengthen your ability to innovate. You critically assess the potential of new methods, tools, and trends, and proactively implement your own ideas in small-scale experiments to test and validate their expected benefits before scaling them into production.

Experience

Your areas of knowledge and expertise

That matter most for this role:

• Master's degree or PhD in a highly quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline

• 3+ years of professional experience in quantitative analytics, data science, or applied statistics.

• Strong hands-on experience in statistical modelling using R or Python, with solid experience working with databases and query languages such as SQL.

• Proven expertise in applying core statistical methods, including regression, classification, and hypothesis testing, to real-world business problems.

• Ability to translate complex analytical results into clear, compelling visualizations and dashboards using tools such as ggplot, R Shiny, or Data Studio.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams.

• Travel: 0-10 %

JOIN THE TEAM

Got what it takes?

In your application we want to see your personal style - what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Apply now

Due to legal reasons, we are obliged to disclose the minimum salary according to the collective agreement for this position, which is EUR 2.362 gross per month. However, our attractive compensation package is based on market-oriented salaries and is therefore significantly above the stated minimum salary. As an employer, we value diversity and support people in developing their potential and strengths, realizing their ideas and seizing opportunities. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, skin colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

Persönliche Stärken einsetzen

ISTA is growing. Grow with us!

Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA) is a constantly growing international institute for conducting world-class research in mathematics, computer science, life sciences & physical sciences. We strive to recruit passionate professionals from across the world over all fields who strive to support our goal of excellent research. Located within a beautiful campus on the outskirts of Vienna, we offer multiple opportunities for personal growth in a stable working environment. Get an insight!

Your responsibilities

ISTA is expanding its portfolio of state‑of‑the‑art scientific services with a new Scientific Service Unit dedicated to experimental chemistry. The Chemistry Support Facility (CSF) offers an array of advanced technologies (X-ray diffraction and spectroscopy, optical spectroscopy) as well as an extensive basic equipment infrastructure spanning from synthetic chemistry to material science applications. In addition to the technical services, the CSF provides an administrative framework to support research groups with the operational aspects of experimental chemistry, such as lab planning, laboratory safety, and chemical waste management. Equipped with state-of-the-art instruments, and staffed with experienced chemists, the CSF's mission is to enable world-class research by providing comprehensive assistance with advanced technologies, and an optimized laboratory infrastructure that facilitates safe, efficient, and innovative research. At ISTA's Chemistry Support Facility, you'll play a pivotal role in overseeing and advancing our cutting-edge equipment park and service portfolio as well as the infrastructure equipment and services. Your expertise and grasp of research methodologies will be essential for providing exceptional support to our scientists.

• Manage and oversee operations of the Chemistry Support Unit, ensuring efficient and high-quality service delivery

• Lead and develop a team of currently 4 colleagues (experts & lab managers)

• Collaborate closely with researchers, both on advanced technologies and infrastructure services

• Develop and implement strategies to optimize facility workflows and introduce innovative methods

• Maintain and troubleshoot instrumentation; plan and execute regular maintenance schedules

• Provide training and user support on instrument use and good laboratory practice

• Collaborate closely with other administrative units on topics like laboratory planning, regulations, and safety

• Manage budgets and resources; prepare service quotes and handle project billing

• Keep updated with advancements in experimental chemistry, integrating relevant innovations into the facility

• Promote the facility's capabilities to attract new research projects and foster collaborations

Your profile

• Advanced degree in Analytical Chemistry, Synthetic Chemistry, Material Science, or a related field with significant experience

• Proven track record in managing a core facility or similar laboratory environment

• Extensive hands-on experience with relevant instruments, and expertise in analytical techniques, general knowledge of a broad portfolio of characterization techniques; Experience with use and maintenance of the instrumentation

• High level of understanding and proven working knowledge of laboratory regulations, safety standards, and good practice

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail and accuracy

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working effectively with a diverse research community

• Excellent command of the English language (both written and spoken)

• Ability to lead and motivate a team, manage multiple tasks, and adhere to tight deadlines

• Experience in project management and budgeting

description_full:
For more than 90 years, PALFINGER has set benchmarks with innovative crane and lifting solutions worldwide. As a leading technology and mechanical engineering company, we transform customer needs into seamlessly integrated solutions while providing opportunities for our people to grow, collaborate, and push beyond limits. We foster an environment where we reach up, reach out, and reach beyond. Become part of our team and let's lift each other to create what's next.

Data Engineer (f/m/d)

Join PALFINGER's Digital Solutions team and help shape the future of data-driven innovation. As a Senior Cloud/AI/ML Architect, you will play a key role in developing and maintaining cloud-based data solutions that transform machine and process data into valuable business insights. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, and business experts, you will contribute to digital products and services that create value for customers and support PALFINGER's Strategy 2030+ vision of innovation, growth, and execution excellence.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, ingestion processes, and transformation workflows that integrate data from a variety of sources, including cloud platforms, databases, APIs, configuration files and business applications

• Develop and optimize cloud-based data architectures, data models, and data provisioning solutions to support analytics, reporting, and machine learning use cases

• Ensure data quality and reliability across the data lifecycle by implementing DataOps best practices including monitoring, testing, validation and failure recovery mechanisms; support MLOps processes

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business requirements, deliver high-quality data products, maintain documentation, and contribute to PALFINGER's data strategy

• Drive continuous improvement and innovation by evaluating new technologies, optimizing infrastructure and cloud costs, and staying up to date with industry trends and advancements

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related technical field, combined with hands-on experience in building and maintaining data processing pipelines

• Strong expertise in data engineering technologies, including SQL, Python/Pandas, Spark, Azure Data Factory, and experience designing scalable data models and architectures

• Solid understanding of modern data platforms and data lake and data warehousing technologies, as well as cloud environments including Azure, AWS, or GCP; knowledge of Databricks or Microsoft Fabric as an advantage

• Experience with software development and agile methodologies, including CI/CD, Git, Scrum or Kanban; knowledge of Terraform, or Azure Bicep is considered a plus

• Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with a self-driven and organized mindset, a passion for continuous learning, and fluency in English in an international business environment

WE OFFER

• Flexible working hours with no core time and possibility to work from home

• Further training and international career opportunities

• Corporate health management "PALfit"

• Company restaurant with freshly prepared meals and daily meal subsidy

• Job ticket for travel to and from PALFINGER

• Numerous employee discounts through Corporate Benefits

Minimum yearly gross salary according to the Austrian metal industry collective agreement is EUR 60.962,30 based on full-time employment. According to experience and qualification, we offer a market-conforming overpayment.

description_full:
Senior Software Architect - Generative AI (m/f/d)

INNIO Group is a global distributed energy solutions provider that delivers reliable, flexible, transient, decentralized, modular and efficient power. With a track record of innovation, INNIO designs, manufactures and services high‑performance power systems under its Jenbacher and Waukesha brands. The company delivers power for applications including data centers, microgrids, grid stabilization, industrial energy and gas compression.
 INNIO operates a global installed base across approximately 100 countries as of December 31, 2025, supported by a resilient, high‑margin services business that delivers long‑term, recurring revenues across the full equipment lifecycle. As electricity demand accelerates--driven by AI, electrification and grid constraints--INNIO enables scalable, behind‑the‑meter power generation with high efficiency, fast start capability, strong transient performance and fuel flexibility, including hydrogen‑ready solutions. INNIO employs over 5,000 people worldwide and is committed to moving energy forward.

What INNIO offers you:

• An innovative and international working environment

• Flexible working time model (depending on position and role)

• Health We Care program - including company sports activities

• Moving cost support for new employees in accordance with policy

• Good connections to public transport - station in direct proximity

• Transportation cost support in accordance with policy

• One of the best canteens in the area with healthy and various meals

• Attractive location in the heart of the Alps with various outdoor sports and leisure possibilities

Your Responsibilities:

• Analyze business requirements and design end‑to‑end Generative AI (GenAI) solution architectures and implementation plans for company‑wide digital initiatives

• Lead research and evaluation of GenAI technologies and trends (foundation models, vector databases, agent orchestration frameworks, MLOps platforms) to develop an INNIO wide GenAI technology roadmap

• Design and evolve a scalable, reusable GenAI application platform (APIs, services, components) that can be leveraged across multiple products and teams

• Define architecture and standards for secure, governed data flows between operational systems, data platforms and GenAI services in alignment with Enterprise Architects

• Establish and review standards for code, prompts, model configurations, and pipelines in line with software engineering best practices, cyber security, responsible AI, and legal/IP requirements

• Work on multiple GenAI initiatives in parallel and supervise, coach and guide software and ML/AI engineers in implementing the target architecture

• Drive and support troubleshooting and optimization of GenAI solutions (quality, latency, cost, reliability, and model behavior) in production environments

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship, evangelizing GenAI best practices with stakeholders across the company

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or related field; Master's degree is a plus

• 7+ years of experience in software development, with expertise in architecting and delivering AI/ML or GenAI applications at scale on public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

• Hands-on experience with LLMs, GenAI patterns (RAG, agent integration, prompt orchestration), Python, and modern AI/ML ecosystems (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Langchain), plus solid software engineering skills (testing, CI/CD, code review)

• Strong skills in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture (microservices, containers, Kubernetes), and modern data storage and retrieval technologies for GenAI workloads (vector databases and relational/time-series databases, e.g., Postgres/MySQL, ClickHouse or similar)

• Strong focus on software quality, performance, maintainability, and security, including awareness of data privacy, governance and responsible AI considerations

• Knowledge of modern development processes and ways of working (Agile/Scrum, DevOps)

• Bonus: Familiarity with additional backend/frontend frameworks (Java/Spring Boot, ReactJS), and contributions to open-source AI projects or a strong portfolio of public GenAI prototypes

• A valid work permit for Austria is a prerequisite for this position (Non-EU citizens: please attach the work permit to the application)

• This role requires 50% presence at the headquarters in Jenbach, Austria

At INNIO, we offer an attractive compensation package that is above the collective agreement for the metal industry. Your qualifications and experience will be considered in an open dialogue during the recruiting process to ensure a market-competitive compensation package.

Interested?
 Please apply via: innio.com/en/careers

Erste Asset Management coordinates and is responsible for all asset management activities of Erste Group and is in charge of assets amounting to more than EUR 111 billion. More than 500 employees develop and manage investment solutions for our investors in 7 different countries. We launched the first environmental fund in Austria more than 25 years ago - at a time when the topic was still a niche. Today, we manage more than EUR 46 billion in sustainability (as of 01.06.2026) and place sustainability at the heart of our business activities.

As a Business Manager, you work at the intersection of investment management, performance controlling, project management and governance. You support the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) in translating strategic priorities into concrete initiatives, processes and decisions and help connect the needs of the Investment Division with the broader organization.The role offers a broad perspective on asset management: from monitoring investment performance and steering cross-functional projects to developing processes, coordinating activities across Austria and CEE and contributing directly to the investment process.

Your Tasks

• Monitor investment performance across EAM's fund range and external fund managers, identify relevant performance or cost developments and coordinate appropriate follow-up measures

• Prepare and coordinate regular performance reviews and management information for the Investment Division

• Manage and steer cross-functional projects covering business, regulatory, process and IT-related topics and support the CIO in company-wide initiatives

• Contribute to the development of governance structures and investment processes, translate new requirements into practical processes and communicate them across the organization

• Strengthen collaboration across EAM's Austrian and CEE investment teams and support the integration and further development of group-wide investment processes

• Coordinate key divisional activities, including budget planning, management meetings and decision-making forums, and work closely with colleagues from Risk, Sales, Product Solutions, Communications and other functions

• Support the further development of the Investment Division's organizational and functional setup, including workforce planning, selection processes and the monitoring of relevant quantitative KPIs

• Build expertise in one or more major asset classes and contribute market and sector insights to investment discussions and key initiatives

Your Background

• A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a comparable field; a Master's degree is preferred

• An analytical and structured working style combined with strong organizational skills, the ability to keep an overview of several topics at the same time and a hands on mentality is key

• Strong project management skills and the ability to structure complex topics, coordinate different stakeholders and drive initiatives from concept to implementation

• Around 1-3 years of professional experience in the asset management industry or a comparable financial-services environment is an advantage

• A good understanding of financial markets, investment products and financial and economic theory

• Experience with performance controlling, product management or investment-related analysis is relevant for this role

• Strong communication and presentation skills, including the confidence to moderate meetings or workshops and communicate complex topics clearly to different audiences

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with investment professionals, management and colleagues across different functions and locations

• The role requires a high level of data literacy and the ability to work effectively with modern AI tools. Candidates do not need to be professional programmers; however, they should be able to quickly solve problems with the help of AI, use relevant software tools, and create simple programs or scripts where necessary. A basic understanding of programming concepts and experience with at least one programming language are advantageous

• professional and personal development (incl. detailed introduction)

• up to 5 days off for learning per year for your additional relevant trainings and further education

description_full:
Vollzeit

SAP Supply Chain Process & Data Governance Specialist

Elsbethen, Österreich

Apply now

As a SAP Supply Chain Process & Data Governance Specialist in our OPS Data & Process Governance team with a focus on our SAP SD/MM + TM tools, you will play a strategic and hands-on role in developing and optimizing operations data, ensuring system reliability, and leading initiatives that enhance our processes.

Your expertise will be critical in supporting and improving our processes, analysing ticket root causes, and proactively addressing issues to prevent recurrence.

You will also take ownership of coordinating and executing small DPG projects, while acting as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders.

As a key part of the OPS Data & Process Governance team at Red Bull Headquarters in Elsbethen (Salzburg), this role leverages extensive expertise in ERP Systems, Transportation Management (TM), and cross-functional processes to support business transformation and strategic improvements within the organisation. The focus lies on utilising deep system knowledge in SD/MM/TM to ensure seamless system performance, proactively identifying and resolving complex process issues, and leading the implementation of impactful system and process optimisations.

Key responsibilities include ownership of strategic initiatives, coordination and management of system-related projects of various scopes and acting as a trusted advisor for process and system related topics. Additionally, the role plays a vital part in fostering knowledge transfer across teams, ensuring alignment of system capabilities with broader business objectives, and promoting a culture of continuous improvement within the organisation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Areas that play to your strengths

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

BUSINESS SUPPORT & SYSTEM MANAGEMENT

Responsible for ensuring smooth operations and high-quality support for SD/MM/TM processes within the organization.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for application end-users, addressing issues and inquiries (1st and 2nd level support) and managing resolution follow-ups with system key users.

• Conduct thorough problem analysis to resolve defects, fulfill requests, and implement solutions while preventing recurring incidents.

• Document findings and collaborate with IT departments and external consultants (3rd level support) to escalate and coordinate resolutions.

• Support cross-functional teams, data owners, and process owners by providing guidance on end-to-end (E2E) data processes and ensuring alignment with proposed solutions.

• Drive data quality improvement initiatives by defining evaluation processes and continuously enhancing data accuracy.

ENHANCEMENTS & SMALL PROJECTS

Lead and contribute to the enhancement of systems and processes by translating business needs into system improvements.

• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and develop pragmatic, solution-oriented approaches to meet operational goals.

• Utilize data analyses to identify opportunities for improvement and oversee the implementation of enhancements while maintaining a customer-centric focus.

• Drive the further development of systems to align with evolving business needs.

TESTING & DOCUMENTATION

Ensure system reliability through rigorous testing and maintain up-to-date documentation for optimal user support and knowledge sharing.

• Coordinate and execute system upgrade tests and validate new developments in collaboration with relevant departments.

• Ensure system process documentation (e.g., BPPs, manuals) remains accurate, consistent, and comprehensive across end-to-end processes.

• Promote the key user concept within Operations by establishing an accessible information platform and encouraging documentation best practices.

• Define and maintain standards for system process documentation to ensure consistency and usability.

TRAINING & KNOWLEDGE TRANSFER

Support organizational growth by driving knowledge transfer initiatives and empowering employees with SAP expertise.

• Develop and deliver cross-functional SAP training programs to ensure all Operations employees have a solid foundation in SAP (e.g., OPS SAP Basic Training).

• Support local key users in fulfilling their roles as knowledge experts by providing advanced training (e.g., SAP Key User Professional Training).

• Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement by promoting a knowledge-sharing environment and ensuring that all team members have access to relevant resources and expertise.

Experience

Your areas of knowledge and expertise

That matter most for this role:

• Minimum of 4 years relevant work experience in SAP ERP Supply Chain roles or similar positions, ideally with a focus on SAP SD/MM and/or Transportation Management (TM).

• Proven expertise in supply chain processes and end-to-end business operations with a strong understanding of cross-functional dependencies.

• Advanced knowledge of SAP systems (focus on SD, MM, TM) with key user experience; familiarity with Business Objects and BI tools is an advantage.

• Demonstrated project management skills, with the ability to lead and execute process improvement or system enhancement initiatives and documentation (JIRA, Confluence ITSM Tools, ARIS).

• Excellent communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex topics and present them to diverse audiences in a clear and impactful way.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with the ability to identify key issues, solve problems, and exploit opportunities.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a logical and efficient approach to tasks and decision-making.

• Ability to evaluate alternative solutions, provide clear recommendations, and proactively communicate with stakeholders across all levels.

• Proven ability to transfer knowledge in a structured and effective manner, supporting the development of teams and individuals.

• Strong resilience, with the ability to manage demanding situations and deliver results under time pressure while maintaining a positive and collaborative attitude.

• Travel: 0-10 %

JOIN THE TEAM

Got what it takes?

In your application we want to see your personal style - what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Apply now

Due to legal reasons, we are obliged to disclose the minimum salary according to the collective agreement for this position, which is EUR 2,605 gross per month. However, our attractive compensation package is based on market-oriented salaries and is therefore significantly above the stated minimum salary. As an employer, we value diversity and support people in developing their potential and strengths, realizing their ideas and seizing opportunities. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, skin colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

Gratkorn

Are you passionate about RF systems and eager to work on cutting-edge NFC solutions for mobile applications? Join our team and play a key role in validating next-generation contactless products used by millions of people worldwide.

Your Responsibilities:

• Lead RF-related NFC system validation projects within a cross-functional development team, with a strong focus on mobile products.

• Plan, track, execute, debug, and report validation activities throughout the product development lifecycle in a global engineering environment.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior RF engineers, supporting them in validation execution and debugging activities.
