Senior Staff Engineer Module Design (f/m/div)

#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks? As a Senior Staff Engineer Module Design on our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?

Your Role


You are looking for a new challenge to apply your broad industry experience in power solutions? As Senior Staff Engineer Module Design you specialize in the design of IBC (Intermediate Bus Converter) power modules and directly interact with our customers to understand their needs and provide technical support. Sounds interesting? Then apply now and join Infineon's Power Systems (PS) division in Austria!

Key responsibilities in your new role

• Design, analyze, and optimize magnetics, thermal, and EMI aspects of power systems to ensure high performance and compliance with standards of our Intermediate Bus Converters

• Engage in analog and digital circuit design, including loop compensation and current sharing techniques by performing comprehensive circuit simulations and PDN analysis to enhance power delivery networks

• Develop and optimize data center power systems, addressing fast transient loads and bi-directional power needs

• Work with I2C/PMBus and other processor protocols, ensuring seamless integration and communication

• Utilize software tools such as Matlab, Simulink, C++, Python, MathCad, and Mathematica for advanced design, analysis and conduct all necessary power system measurement

• Create and review schematics, applying advanced PCB layout techniques and ensuring product safety compliance

• Develop and implement manufacturing test metrics and ensure manufacturability from the beginning

Your Profile


You communicate effectively, manage projects efficiently and produce high-quality technical documentation. You enjoy engaging with customers and providing technical support.

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

• University / University of Applied Sciences degree in Electrical Engineering, Informatics or Physics

• 6+ years of industry experience in power solutions, specifically in power modules with deep understanding of data center power systems and all relevant power topologies

• Proficiency in magnetics design, EMI, thermal design and power electronics

• Extensive experience with analog and digital circuit design, loop compensation and current sharing

• Expert knowledge in circuit simulation and PDN analysis

• Skills in dealing with fast transient loads and bi-directional power systems

• Proficiency in I2C/PMBus and processor protocols

• Advanced skills in Matlab, Simulink, C++, Python, MathCad, Mathematica and experience with schematic capture tools such as Allegro with strong capabilities in PCB layout guidance and product safety standards

• Proficiency in FEA, FEMM, Sonnet, and CST software tools

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.

#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks? As a Senior Staff Engineer Module Design on our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?

Your Role


You are looking for a new challenge to apply your broad industry experience in power solutions? As Senior Staff Engineer Module Design you specialize in the design of IBC (Intermediate Bus Converter) power modules and directly interact with our customers to understand their needs and provide technical support. Sounds interesting? Then apply now and join Infineon's Power Systems (PS) division in Austria!

Key responsibilities in your new role

• Design, analyze, and optimize magnetics, thermal, and EMI aspects of power systems to ensure high performance and compliance with standards of our Intermediate Bus Converters

• Engage in analog and digital circuit design, including loop compensation and current sharing techniques by performing comprehensive circuit simulations and PDN analysis to enhance power delivery networks

• Develop and optimize data center power systems, addressing fast transient loads and bi-directional power needs

• Work with I2C/PMBus and other processor protocols, ensuring seamless integration and communication

• Utilize software tools such as Matlab, Simulink, C++, Python, MathCad, and Mathematica for advanced design, analysis and conduct all necessary power system measurement

• Create and review schematics, applying advanced PCB layout techniques and ensuring product safety compliance

• Develop and implement manufacturing test metrics and ensure manufacturability from the beginning

• Drive technical decisions and lead the project to production readiness including stakeholder management

Your Profile


You communicate effectively, manage projects efficiently and produce high-quality technical documentation. You enjoy engaging with customers and providing technical support.

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

• University / University of Applied Sciences degree in Electrical Engineering, Informatics or Physics

• 8+ years of industry experience in power solutions, specifically in power modules with deep understanding of data center power systems and all relevant power topologies

• Proficiency in magnetics design, EMI, thermal design and power electronics

• Extensive experience with analog and digital circuit design, loop compensation and current sharing

• Expert knowledge in circuit simulation and PDN analysis

• Skills in dealing with fast transient loads and bi-directional power systems

• Proficiency in I2C/PMBus and processor protocols

• Advanced skills in Matlab, Simulink, C++, Python, MathCad, Mathematica and experience with schematic capture tools such as Allegro with strong capabilities in PCB layout guidance and product safety standards

• Proficiency in FEA, FEMM, Sonnet, and CST software tools

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/). title: Lead AI Engineer (Java or .NET)

As Lead AI Engineer at SQUER it's your job to plan and coordinate the development of new digital initiatives for our clients and, by doing so, ensure project success. In the process, you will have the opportunity to lead the design of architectures as well as develop state-of-the-art software systems.

Your Tasks

• Experience with established frontend (Angular, React, Vue.js) as well as backend frameworks (Spring Boot, Express, .NET core)

• Good understanding of software architectures, cloud-native development, and containerization (Docker or Kubernetes).

• You continuously improve AI adoption throughout the entire SDLC, resolve bottlenecks and feel passionate about enabling software teams in all their disciplines.

• Trainings and development of your skills are highly important to you. Moreover, you enjoy passing on acquired knowledge.

• You are fluent in English (written and spoken) in order to communicate in the best way possible with colleagues and partners. German is a plus

Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:

• Ownership & Responsibility: at SQUER, we believe in empowering our team. In our flat hierarchies, your ideas and actions matter more than titles. Take the reins, make an impact and grow with us.

• Learn & Grow: Tap into a EUR 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.

• Exciting Challenges & Real Impact: Dive into diverse projects where your work truly makes a difference - for our clients and for SQUER.

• Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.

• Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration and leverage our suite of AI tools and licenses (Anthropic, OpenAI, and more) to suit your working style.

• We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.

• Be Part of a Thriving Team Culture: At SQUER, collaboration and connection are at the heart of what we do. Through open communication, shared successes, and meaningful team events - including our annual SQUER offsite - we cultivate a culture where everyone feels valued and inspired to grow together.

• A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

Salary

We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between EUR 75.000 and EUR 95.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

description_full:
Vollzeit

IT Sales Applications Project Manager

Elsbethen, Österreich

Apply now

As part of our Sales Applications Team, this role involves shaping the future of our business application landscape. By leading strategic IT initiatives across Sales, Finance, and eCommerce, you'll drive digital transformation, enable business growth, and deliver solutions that create value on a global scale.

As an IT Sales Applications Project Manager, you'll drive impactful initiatives across our global Sales, Finance, and eCommerce landscape, partnering with business leaders, IT experts, and external partners to deliver innovative solutions that accelerate growth, optimize processes, and create lasting business value. Taking full ownership from concept to go-live, you'll shape the future of our application ecosystem while leading transformative projects in an international environment. If you thrive in a dynamic international environment, enjoy turning business challenges into impactful solutions, and want to shape the future of Sales, Finance, and eCommerce applications, this is your opportunity.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Areas that play to your strengths

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

PROJECT MANAGEMENT

In this role, you'll lead international IT projects across Sales, Finance, and eCommerce, taking full ownership from initial concept through successful deployment. This includes defining project scope, timelines, milestones, budgets, and resource requirements, while proactively managing risks, issues, and dependencies throughout the project lifecycle. Working with cross-functional teams and external implementation partners, you'll ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with business objectives.

BUSINESS ANALYSIS & REQUIREMENTS MANAGEMENT

In close collaboration with business stakeholders, you'll analyze existing processes, identify challenges, and translate business needs into clear and actionable requirements. You'll facilitate workshops, evaluate solution options, and help design scalable and sustainable approaches that deliver tangible business value. By challenging the status quo and identifying opportunities for optimization, you'll contribute to the continuous improvement of both processes and applications.

SOLUTION DELIVERY & QUALITY ASSURANCE

You'll coordinate all phases of solution delivery, including design, testing, deployment, and hypercare, ensuring that solutions meet defined business requirements and quality standards. By overseeing go-live activities and working closely with business teams, support functions, and external partners, you'll ensure smooth implementation and successful adoption. Throughout the project lifecycle, you'll monitor progress, proactively address delivery risks, and facilitate a seamless transition into operational support.

STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT & COMMUNICATION

Building strong relationships across business and IT functions will be key to your success. You'll act as a trusted partner for stakeholders, consultants, and delivery teams, ensuring alignment and transparent communication throughout project execution. By providing clear updates, managing expectations, resolving issues, and supporting change management activities, you'll drive engagement and help ensure successful project outcomes.

BUSINESS APPLICATIONS & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

Beyond project delivery, you'll play an active role in shaping and continuously improving our Sales and eCommerce application landscape. Together with business stakeholders and technical experts, you'll identify opportunities to optimize systems and processes, drive application enhancements from concept to implementation, and ensure that business applications continue to evolve with changing business needs. You'll also contribute to application governance, documentation, and knowledge sharing to support long-term operational excellence.

Experience

Your areas of knowledge and expertise

That matter most for this role:

• University degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related field

• Project management certification (e.g., PMP or PRINCE2) is considered an advantage

• Fluent English skills, German is a plus

• At least five years of experience in delivering IT projects, business application initiatives, or related technology projects

• Proven track record of managing projects throughout the full project lifecycle, from initiation to deployment

• Experience in business requirements engineering, stakeholder collaboration, and managing external implementation partners, ideally combined with hands-on expertise in SAP and CRM solutions

• Exposure to Snowflake, reporting, and data and analytics platforms is a plus

• Ideally, experience in the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and IT teams

• Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Travel: 0-10 %

JOIN THE TEAM

Got what it takes?

In your application we want to see your personal style - what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Apply now

Due to legal reasons we are obliged to disclose the minimum salary according to the collective agreement for this position, which is EUR 2,362 gross per month. However, our attractive compensation package is based on market-oriented salaries and is therefore significantly above the stated minimum salary. As an employer, we value diversity and support people in developing their potential and strengths, realizing their ideas and seizing opportunities. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, skin colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

description_full:
Internship - Lab Verification Engineer in the AMS Lab of the Development Center Villach (f/m/div)

#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Your Role

In a rapidly digitizing world, the interfaces between analog and digital domains are essential enablers of modern technology. Join the largest Analog-Mixed-Signal (AMS) verification laboratory team at Infineon, dedicated to analog and digital measurement. Our labs verify a wide range of devices, including:

• Analog blocks in Infineon microcontrollers

• Analog to Digital (ADC) and Digital to Analog (DAC) converters

• High-speed interfaces and High Precision Oscillators and PLLs

• Power Management Systems (PMS) and Battery Management Systems (BMS)

• DCDC Converters for low voltage applications and Linear Voltage Regulators (LDOs)

• RF blocks for radar systems and Bias & Control circuits for 5G antennas

Key responsibilities in your new role

Take this opportunity to expand your theoretical knowledge and acquire practical, hands-on experience in areas such as:

• Analog-Mixed-Signal Integrated Circuits: Understand and work with semiconductor integrated circuits

• Measurement Equipment and Techniques: Gain experience with the latest AMS measurement tools and acquire expertise in AMS measurement techniques

• Board-Level Skills: Learn board assembly, rework, and soldering

• Debugging and Problem Solving: Develop skills to identify root causes of unexpected behavior and understand parasitic effects on circuit performance

• Data Management and Automation: Handle big data, conduct post-processing, and automate lab test setups

• Effective Communication: Prepare, present, and document measurement results according to high-quality standards

• Comprehensive Hands-On Experience: Combine theoretical knowledge with practical application across diverse AMS areas

You will also benefit from working in a dynamic, international environment with more than 100 previous student interns, many of whom have joined the lab or Infineon's global teams as engineers.

Ready for a challenge? Submit your application and become part of our vibrant lab community!

 Further Information
 Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
 Duration: min. 6 months

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

• Educational Background: Enrolled as a student in Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field

• Lab Equipment Expertise: Familiarity with using laboratory equipment

• Programming Knowledge: Understanding of programming languages such as C, C#, or C++

• Language Skills: Good English skills

• Internship Commitment: Willingness to complete an internship of at least 6 months, preferably 1 year or more

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf[)](https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2025.pdf%29).

Please attach the following documents (German or English) to your application:

• Motivation letter

• CV

• Certificate of matriculation at a university

• Latest Transcript of records (not older than 6 months)

• Highest completed educational certificate (Matura certificate for Bachelor students, Bachelor certificate for Master students)

• Reference letter (optional)

Contact:

Nico Steinhauser

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
 As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
 Are you in?

 We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.
 This means we embrace diversity and inclusion and welcome everyone for who they are. At Infineon, we offer a working environment characterized by trust, openness, respect and tolerance and are committed to give all applicants and employees equal opportunities. We base our recruiting decisions on the applicant´s experience and skills. Learn more about our various contact channels.

We foster an environment where we reach up, reach out, and reach beyond. Become part of our team and let's lift each other to create what's next.

Application Engineer Tuning Center KBC (f/m/d)

• Degree in mechanical engineering (TU/FH/HTL) or a comparable technical education

• Experience in project management within technical development environments

• Knowledge of PLM systems, CAD/CAE environments and product data management

• Strong communication and teamwork skills with a structured and analytical way of working

• Good written and spoken English and a customer‑oriented mindset with solid problem‑solving skills

WHAT WE OFFER

• Flexible working hours with no core time and possibility to work from home

• Further training and international career opportunities

• Corporate health management "PALfit"

• Company restaurant with freshly prepared meals and daily meal subsidy

description_full:
Senior Staff Engineer Chip Package Board - CoDesign Flow and Methodology (f/m/div)

#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. Join the thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers behind tomorrow's technology. As a Senior Staff Engineer Chip Package Board - CoDesign Flow and Methodology on our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

• Define and drive the technical roadmap for Chip-Package-Board (CPB) design methodologies, flows, tools, and digital engineering capabilities. Partner closely with Business Lines, Design Centers, and engineering communities to understand current and future product requirements, technology trends, and business challenges

• Translate Business Line needs into methodology enhancements, design-flow improvements, simulation capabilities, automation concepts, and EDA roadmap requirements. Act as the technical brid ge between Business Lines, methodology teams, software teams, IT organizations, and EDA vendors

• Drive continuous improvement of CPB methodologies and engineering workflows to accelerate design convergence, improve design quality, and increase first-pass success. Establish scalable, reusable, and sustainable methodology solutions, standards, and governance models across the CPB ecosystem

• Identify and shape future capabilities required for advanced packaging, heterogeneous integration, System-in-Package (SiP), 3D design methodologies, multi-domain simulation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. Evaluate and influence EDA vendor technologies and industry trends to ensure alignment with Infineon's future business needs

• Lead AI, automation, data, and digitalization initiatives that deliver measurable engineering and business value. Drive the evolution towards an integrated, data-driven, AI-enabled, and highly automated CPB co-design environment

• Provide technical leadership, consulting, training, and enablement for global user communities and stakeholders. Build strong partnerships across engineering functions and drive adoption of methodology and digital engineering solutions

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

• Degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Physics, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with a minimum of 8 years of experience in semiconductor development, design methodologies, EDA environments, package development, design automation, simulation, or related engineering fields

• Strong understanding of semiconductor product development, including chip, package, board, simulation, and system-level interactions. Ability to understand Business Line challenges, technology roadmaps, and future product requirements, and translate them into methodology strategies, flow enhancements, and technical development roadmaps

• Proven experience in defining, optimizing, and deploying engineering methodologies and design flows. Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to identify future requirements and drive technology evolution beyond day-to-day operational support

• Experience working with EDA technologies and vendors (e.g., Cadence, Synopsys, Keysight, Comsol). Good understanding of digitalization, automation, AI-enabled engineering workflows, and data-driven engineering concepts. Software development experience is beneficial but not the primary focus of the role

• Strong customer-oriented mindset with the ability to balance operational excellence with long-term methodology, technology, and business strategy

• Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives involving Business Lines, methodology teams, software organizations, IT functions, and external partners. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills with the ability to align diverse teams around a common technical vision

• Ability to act as a trusted technical partner for Business Lines, combining deep engineering understanding with strong business awareness and a passion for enabling future product innovation

• Fluent English skills are required; German language skills are considered a strong advantage

The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.

Contact:

Maria Pollai-Schlintl, LinkedIn

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
 As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.

 We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

Software Test Engineer (f/m/d)

apply smart

Fast Facts

• Knowledge: Software testing, industrial automation, test design, defect analysis, quality assurance, experience with Linux is a plus

• Location: Salzburg, Austria

• Level: Junior

You like breaking software -- so users don't have to.

As a Software Tester, you help ensure that zenon works reliably in real-world environments. You test, analyse and improve -- with a clear focus on quality.

 Quality isn't a checkbox. It's what makes zenon work -- everywhere.

 #Staycurious. Make quality visible.

apply smart

Key tasks

• Plan and execute manual software tests

• Create test concepts and generate test data

• Perform functional, integration, system and performance testing

• Analyze and document test results and manage defect tracking

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing strategy

Your profile

• Technical education (e.g. apprenticeship, technical college, or university) or first hands-on experience in software testing or industrial automation

• Familiarity with test tools and test environments

• Experience with Linux is a plus

• Interest in industrial automation

• Strong self-organization, sense of ownership and problem-solving skills

• Clear and confident communication skills

• Good English skills, written and spoken

Depending on professional experience, this position is at least classified according to the IT collective agreement in ST1/entry level. The final gross salary is in line with the market and is based on your training, qualifications and experience.

apply smart

This position is part of the zenon software engineering team.

Which special skills/soft skills should I bring to the table?

 The main thing is your desire to create real added value for our customers. Passion for software solutions, coding or testing is as important as a hunger for new technologies and knowledge. You need to be detail-oriented, willing to learn, organized and proactive. A certain degree of nerdiness is perfect, because it shows you want to deepen your knowledge and gain expertise in a specific area.

More information

Interested?

We are COPA-DATA, a global independent software development company. We solve highly complex tasks as per our motto:

There is always an easier way.

zenon is our successful software platform, developed for automation and digitization projects as well as to implement sustainability goals in production companies. You've probably enjoyed food or drinks, have taken medication or a ride in a car that was produced with the help of zenon. Or maybe your electricity provider works with our software? It's quite possible that we've already been connected, even if indirectly.

Bettina Weber

 Recruiting Specialist
 +43 662 431002116

apply smart

Benefits

• Flexible work times
 Everything is possible. Stay fully flexible and balanced. Early riser or night owl? No matter. However, we firmly believe that collaborating is best done in person, especially when it comes to crucial solutions.

• Company pension plan
 Benefits for today and tomorrow. COPA-DATA offers all employees a voluntary pension plan. It can be increased individually with your own, tax incentivised contributions.

• Health
 Active and healthy. In addition to the occupational health care provided by our company doctor and occupational psychologist, we offer weekly Shiatsu. We cover a part of the costs. There are also discounted private health insurance rates by means of group health insurance.

• Home office
 Easy planning with the option to work from home 2 days a week.

• Real work life balance
 We strive for the best possible transparency. Our work policies ensure clarity, appreciation and fairness.

• Lunch allowance
 A food allowance to suit your taste. The monthly top-up can be redeemed in all restaurants and at delivery and take out service Lieferando, both at work and at home.

• Company bike
 Stay mobile, for the environment and for your finances. Take out a tax-deductible bicycle lease from Firmenradl.at. It also keeps you fit.

• Further education/training
 Stay at the forefront, always. We offer you selected cutting-edge further education as well as training opportunities, courses and coaching.

Your path to us

1. CV Screening

 A good CV speaks for itself. Ideally succinct, to the point and just like you.

2. Meeting in person

 We prefer to talk openly, in person and in detail. If things have to move quickly, we can meet online. That's all we need for a first impression. Sounds good?

3. Trial Day

 You'll get to know the people you're going to work with and the tasks you're going to work on. You'll get an idea of who we are and can show us who you are. Let's talk freely. We'll take our time, so we can find out together if we're a match.

4. Signing the contract

 Off to new shores together. Your onboarding will be tailored to you. We don't care about hitting goals immediately, but about seeing you grow alongside us.

Marketing Data Engineer (m/w/d)

Verbinde Daten, Systeme und Marketing und schaffe so die Grundlage für personalisierte Customer Journeys.

Das Wichtigste vorab:

Arbeitsort: Wien

Gehalt: ab EUR 3.500,- brutto/Monat bei 38,5h/Woche je nach Qualifikation/Erfahrung

Homeoffice: bis zu 2 Tage möglich

Start: ab 05. Oktober 2026

Deine Mission

Du vereinst Data Engineering mit analytischer Denkweise und fühlst dich in der Welt von Marketing Automation zuhause? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Daten relevante Kundenkommunikation wird. Von Datenmodellen und Integrationen bis zur zentralen Kundensicht schaffst du die Grundlage für personalisierte Customer Journeys, automatisierte Kampagnen und datengetriebene Entscheidungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Marketing, CRM und Engineering zusammen, stellst eine verlässliche Datenbasis sicher und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.

Was besser gelöst werden kann oder ungenutztes Potenzial bietet, bringst du aktiv ein und gestaltest gemeinsam mit dem Team nachhaltige Lösungen.

Deine Aufgaben im Detail:

Die Datenbasis für Marketing Automation weiterentwickeln

•

Du baust skalierbare Datenmodelle und eine zentrale 360°-Kundensicht aus CRM-, Nutzungs- und Vertragsdaten und entwickelst sie weiter.

•

Du stellst sicher, dass personalisierte und automatisierte Kundenkommunikation auf den richtigen Kunden- und Verhaltensdaten aufsetzt.

•

Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Marketing und Lifecycle in datenbasierte Automatisierungslogik, etwa Trigger, Segmente und Customer Journeys.

Datenplattformen und Integrationen weiterentwicklen

•

Du baust, betreibst und optimierst die Datenintegrationen und Schnittstellen zur Marketing-Automation-Plattform.

•

Du führst CRM-, Verhaltens- und Produktnutzungsdaten zusammen und hältst sie über alle Systeme hinweg konsistent.

•

Du überwachst die Datenflüsse, sicherst ihre Qualität und löst Fehler, bevor sie in Kampagnen sichtbar werden.

Analytics und datengetriebene Entscheidungen ermöglichen

•

Du schaffst die analytischen Grundlagen für Segmentierung, Personalisierung, Churn-Prognosen und Customer-Lifecycle-Modelle.

•

Du entwickelst die KPI-, Reporting- und ROI-Frameworks, mit denen wir die Marketing-Performance messen und verbessern. Die Kennzahlen selbst definiert das Marketing, du sorgst dafür, dass sie belastbar sind.

Tracking und Erfolgsmessung vorantreiben

•

Du konzipierst Tracking- und Tagging-Konzepte für die digitalen Kanäle und entwickelst sie weiter.

•

Du sicherst die Qualität des Trackings als Basis für Automatisierung, Analysen und Reporting.

Datenqualität und Compliance sicherstellen

•

Du sorgst für hohe Datenqualität und die Einhaltung von Datenschutz-, Governance- und Compliance-Anforderungen.

•

Du definierst und implementierst Standards für Datenbereinigung, Aufbewahrung, Löschung und Einwilligungsmanagement.

Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen

•

Die zentrale Kundensicht steht und wird vom Marketing tatsächlich für Segmentierung und Automatisierung genutzt.

•

Die Integrationen laufen stabil, Probleme fallen durch Monitoring auf und nicht durch eine fehlgelaufene Kampagne.

•

Datenqualität und Einwilligungslogik sind dokumentiert und geprüft, sodass Kampagnen in jedem Markt regelkonform laufen.

•

Marketing kann neue Lifecycle-Anwendungsfälle umsetzen, ohne dass jedes Mal die Datengrundlage neu gebaut werden muss.

Dein Profil:

•

Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Data Engineering mit, idealerweise ergänzt durch Kenntnisse in Data Science, Advanced Analytics oder Marketing Analytics.

•

Du hast im Umfeld von Marketing Automation und datengetriebenem Customer Lifecycle Management gearbeitet.

•

Du kennst dich fundiert mit Datenmodellierung, ETL- und ELT-Prozessen und Datenqualitätsmanagement aus.

•

Du hast Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, Marketing-Automation-Plattformen und komplexen Systemintegrationen.

•

Du denkst analytisch und übersetzt Geschäftsanforderungen in skalierbare Datenlösungen.

•

Du kennst dich mit DSGVO, Consent Management und Data Governance aus.

•

Erfahrung mit HubSpot ist ein großer Vorteil, insbesondere bei CRM-Datenmodellen, Custom Objects, Workflows, Segmentierung und Datensynchronisation.

•

Du arbeitest gern in interdisziplinären Teams mit Marketing, CRM, Produktmanagement und Engineering.

•

Ausgezeichnete Deutsch (C1/C2)- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Ein motiviertes Team:

In dieser Funktion bist du Teil des group.one Marketing DACH-Teams. Du arbeitest in einem vernetzten Umfeld mit top qualifizierten Kolleg:innen in Wien und Deutschland, die standort- und teamübergreifend zusammenarbeiten.

Du übernimmst eine Schlüsselrolle an der Schnittstelle von Daten, Technologie und Marketing. Mit deiner Arbeit schaffst du die Grundlage für Customer Journeys, Marketing Automation und Kundenbindung und gestaltest deren Weiterentwicklung aktiv mit. Dazu kommen vielfältige persönliche und berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

description_full:
QA/QC Quality Engineer (all genders)

Data Center Wien | Vollzeit | Wien

INTRO

Zaunergroup ist internationaler Partner für Engineering, Anlagenbau und Industrieservices in den Bereichen Energie, Industrie und Infrastruktur. Für unsere Projekte im Bereich Data Center Vienna suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als QA/QC Quality Engineer für spannende Data Center Projekte. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung der Qualitätsstandards während der gesamten Bau- und Montagephase eines anspruchsvollen Rechenzentrumsprojekts.

AUFGABEN

• Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards auf der Baustelle

• Durchführung und Dokumentation von Qualitätskontrollen im Anlagen- und Rohrleitungsbau, sowie allen HKLS-Gewerken

• Erstellung und Pflege von QA/QC-Dokumentationen gemäß Projekt- und Kund:innenvorgaben,

• Koordination von Inspektionen, Prüfungen und Abnahmen mit Kund:innen, Subunternehmer:innen und internen Teams

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Prüfplänen, ITPs (Inspection and Test Plans) und Qualitätsverfahren

• Nachverfolgung von Abweichungen, Non-Conformities (NCR) sowie Unterstützung bei Corrective Actions

• Mitwirkung bei Druckprüfungen, Inspektionen und Inbetriebnahme Aktivitäten

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitung, Bauleitung sowie der zentralen Qualitätsabteilung

QUALIFIKATIONEN

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (Lehre, HTL, FH oder Universität) im Bereich Maschinenbau, Anlagenbau, Verfahrenstechnik oder vergleichbar

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich QA/QC im Anlagenbau, Rohrleitungsbau oder in industriellen Großprojekten (Schwerpunkt HKLS)

• Kenntnisse relevanter Qualitätsstandards, Prüfverfahren und Dokumentationsanforderungen

• Erfahrung mit technischen Dokumentationen, Prüfprotokollen und Inspektionsabläufen

• Strukturierte, detailorientierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Durchsetzungsvermögen auf der Baustelle

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

WAS BIETEN WIR?

UNSERE BENEFITS

Aus- und Weiterbildung

Wir fördern persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. Ziele und Kurse werden jährlich abgestimmt, ob intern oder extern - Weiterbildung ist bei uns garantiert. Keep on learning!

 Bring a Friend

Empfehlungen von Mitarbeiter:innen sind uns wichtig. Für die erfolgreiche Vermittlung neuer Kolleg:innen, die unsere Werte teilen, gibt es eine großzügige Prämie.

 Betriebsrat

Unser Betriebsrat bietet zusätzliche Benefits wie Zuschüsse, Vergünstigungen bei Partnerfirmen, betriebliche Zukunftssicherung und kleine Aufmerksamkeiten zu besonderen Anlässen.

 Easy Arrival

Unser Hauptstandort in Wallern ist ideal gelegen, mit schneller Anbindung und staufreier Erreichbarkeit, was den Arbeitsweg stressfrei macht. Außerdem stehen an unseren Standorten ausreichend Parkplätze zur Verfügung.

 Save some Money

Jeder Standort bietet seinen Mitarbeiter:innen spezielle Rabatte von unseren Partnerbetrieben. Wo genau, ist in der Willkommens-Mappe nachzulesen.

 Welcome on Board

Wir legen großen Wert auf ein persönliches Onboarding. Neue Kolleg:innen erhalten am ersten Arbeitstag eine umfassende Einschulung, einen Rundgang und eine arbeitsplatzbezogene Einführung. Neue Heroes sollen sich gleich als Teil der Familie fühlen.

 Das Wir zählt

Wir sehen mehr in den Menschen - unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Orientierung oder körperlicher Verfassung. Wir leben das "Du" und schaffen echten Zusammenhalt. Denn gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr.

 Open-Door-Kultur

Unsere Türen stehen immer offen. Transparenz und Offenheit sind für uns die Grundlage für ein vertrauensvolles Miteinander.

 International

Wir arbeiten international an vielen spannenden Projekten. Unsere Teams setzen sich dabei aus Kolleg:innen vieler Nationen zusammen. Einzigartige Gelegenheit, um internationale Erfahrung zu sammeln.

 Connected to Home

Um die Verbindung zur Familie in der Heimat aufrecht zu halten, ermöglichen wir unseren Mitarbeiter:innen auf den Baustellen regelmäßige Heimreisen.

GEHALT

Wir möchten darauf hinweisen, dass das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt im attraktiven KV Metallgewerbe bei jährlich brutto EUR 44.399,46 liegt. Das tatsächliche Gehalt liegt innerhalb einer Bandbreite von jährlich brutto EUR 45.000,00 bzw. EUR 65.000 und wird gemeinsam mit Ihnen festgelegt. Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Grundgehalt erhalten Sie ein attraktives Entsendevergütungspaket mit zusätzlichen finanziellen und materiellen Vorteilen für Ihren Auslandseinsatz.

Werde Teil der Zaunergroup

ANSPRECHPARTNER:IN

Uns bei der Zaunergroup ist persönlicher Kontakt besonders wichtig. Umso mehr, wenn's um neue Kolleg:innen geht. Hier findest du darum gleich die passende Ansprechperson für deine Bewerbung und natürlich für alle Fragen, die du noch hast. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören.

Mag. Petra Eder

Department Lead Strategic HR Management

 The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. title: Backend Developer (m/f/d)
description_full:
Are you passionate about the outdoors and ready to make an impact at Europe's leading platform for outdoor activities?

checkyeti is seeking a Backend Developer who thrives on variety and impact -- someone who ships fast and still holds a high bar on architecture, testing, and code they can defend in review. In this position, you'll take direct responsibility for the services that power our platform and build them with AI agents as a core part of the workflow.

How We Work at checkyeti
 checkyeti is Europe's leading platform for outdoor & nature activities, connecting travelers with 16,000+ adventures across 1,500+ destinations." as our main statement.

At checkyeti, we thrive on a collaborative culture where cross-functional teams -- from Marketing to Business Development and Operations -- work hand-in-hand. Our flat hierarchy ensures that everyone, regardless of role or seniority, is empowered to make a real impact from day one.

Within the Product team, we build event-driven microservices running on AWS, primarily powered by Java, Spring Boot, and Project Reactor. We manage data using MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and Redis, and maintain fast continuous delivery (releasing multiple times weekly) using automated CI/CD pipelines with Docker and Jenkins within an agile framework. Our platform's AI features run on GCP with Gemini, and we use Claude Code day to day to move faster.

Backend Developer (m/f/d)

What You Will Do in This Role

You will become a key player in our engineering team. Your mission is to build, scale, and optimize the core backend systems that power our platform:

• Build AI-First: Use Claude Code as your default workflow -- from scoping and prototyping to refactoring and test coverage. You'll help shape how our team works with coding agents: what we automate, where we keep humans in the loop, and how we hold quality steady as output volume goes up.

• Build High-Impact Features: Design, build, and deploy scalable backend services that deliver tangible business value and enhance the platform experience for our customers.

• Ensure Quality & Reliability: Write clean, maintainable code backed by robust unit and integration tests to guarantee high performance, security, and continuous deployment stability.

• Architect for Scale: Partner closely with our CTO and technical architects to optimize platform performance, high availability, and backend system architecture.

• Tackle Operational Challenges: Proactively identify and resolve technical edge cases and operational challenges alongside the engineering team.

• Innovate & Modernize: Stay ahead of software engineering trends, evaluating and introducing modern technologies and practices that elevate our tech stack and team workflow.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work hand-in-hand with frontend developers, product managers, and operational teams to transform product requirements into seamless technical solutions.

Who We Are Looking For

You are a quality-driven software engineer who combines strong core Java expertise with fluency in AI coding agents, plus a passion for scalable system architecture, proactive problem-solving, and continuous value delivery.

• AI-Native Engineering: You already work with coding agents daily and have opinions about it -- where they save you hours, where they quietly produce garbage, and how you review generated code before it reaches a PR. You're comfortable being accountable for code you didn't type line by line.

• Core Engineering Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on Java. Experience with Spring Boot and reactive programming is a strong plus.

• Database & Data Architecture: You have 2+ years of experience working with relational databases like MySQL (exposure to Redis, MongoDB, or Elasticsearch is a great plus).

• Ownership: You thrive when taking full responsibility for your work -- from initial architectural discussions to writing clean code, deploying, and maintaining feature health.

• Pragmatic Team Player: You communicate openly, actively seek and give constructive feedback. You bring flexibility, strong commitment, and stay focused on shipping reliable, well-tested code in an agile environment.

• Linguistic Skills: Professional fluency in English is essential as it is our company's daily working language.

What We Offer

• Real Impact & Freedom to Innovate: In our dynamic scale-up environment, you have the freedom to initiate and implement innovative technical ideas, shape our backend architecture, and see your code directly impact millions of users.

• Mentorship & Technical Growth: Accelerate your career through hands-on technical coaching and regular 1-on-1 feedback sessions directly with our CTO and platform architects.

• Choose Your Own Hardware: Work with the hardware and operating system you perform best with (Mac, Linux, or Windows).

• Hybrid Setup: Enjoy a flexible work setup with two home office days and three office days per week.

• Flexible Perks: A monthly budget for a perk of your choice (e.g., Edenred meal vouchers or public transport) and a discount on all checkyeti outdoor activities.

• Social Events: Become part of the checkyeti community! We host a mix of team and company-wide events at least once per quarter to celebrate our successes together.

• Office Wellness: Stay fueled with free barista coffee, fresh fruit, and cold beverages in the office. Plus, stay active with free access to our shared company cards for the John Reed gym located right in our building.

• Prime Vienna Location: Work with an international team in the heart of Vienna, right next to the State Opera. For those moving to the city, we'll share all our best local tips and tricks to help you navigate and enjoy your new life in the city!

Salary

A gross annual salary from EUR56,000, with willingness to overpay depending on experience and qualifications.

Join Us!

Ideally, you are available to join us by October 2026 -- alternative start dates and notice periods will be discussed on a case-by-case basis. The interview process includes three stages: a remote intro call, a technical session where you'll work on a real problem with the AI tools you normally use, and a conversation about architecture and system design with our CTO. After each stage you'll hear back from us within five working days.

Be part of our journey to becoming Europe's number one platform for booking outdoor activities. We look forward to meeting you!

At checkyeti, we are proud to evaluate all candidates based on their skills and potential, regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or religion.

description_full:
Do your life's best work to
 make the world a safer place.

Operational Product Manager - Infrastructure Team Public Transport (all genders)

Public Transport

• Wien

• FREQUENTIS AG

• Vollzeit

Über Frequentis

Frequentis Group mit Headquarter in Wien ist ein internationaler Anbieter von Kommunikations- und Informationssystemen für Leitzentralen mit sicherheitskritischen Aufgaben. Weltweit vertrauen bereits über 500 Kunden in rund 150 Ländern mit mehr als 45.000 Arbeitsplätzen unserem KnowHow und langjähriger Erfahrung.

In der Business Unit Public Transport stehen wir vor einem technologischen Umbruch von GSM-R zu FRMCS, bei allen unseren europäischen Bahnkunden. Unser Geschäftsbereich Public Transport ermöglicht und begleitet eine sanfte Migration unserer bestehenden Lösungen hin zu dem neuen Zugfunk Standard. So leisten wir und Sie einen Beitrag zur Mobilität der Zukunft und zur Verbesserung der Umweltbilanz des Verkehrssektor ("Green Deal").

Das Infrastructure Team verantwortet die Plattform auf der unsere Produktlösung (FTS 3020) aufbaut, es handelt sich um alle SW-Bestandteile sowie damit verbundene OSI-Schichten unterhalb der Anwendungsschicht. Dazu zählen insbesondere Betriebssysteme, Container- und Plattformtechnologien, Datenbanken, Middleware, Automatisierung, Security Services, Storage, Netzwerk, Virtualisierung und Plattformarchitektur.

Als Operational Product Manager (OPM) strukturieren, priorisieren und koordinieren Sie diese Themen. Sie müssen nicht selbst die tiefste technische Lösung entwerfen, aber Sie müssen technische Diskussionen verstehen und einordnen können, die richtigen Fragen stellen, Entscheidungsgrundlagen erarbeiten und aus einzelnen Anforderungen belastbare Roadmaps, Budget- und Umsetzungspläne ableiten.

Aufgaben

• Organisatorische Koordination eines kleinen, spezialisierten Cross-functional Teams mit Software Architect, Security Agents, erfahrenem Lead Engineer und Junior Engineer.

• Strukturierte Aufnahme, Bewertung und Priorisierung von Anforderungen aus Kundenprojekten, Product Management, Engineering, Delivery, Security, Einkauf und Operations.

• Übersetzung technischer Infrastrukturthemen in verständliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen: Business Value, Kundennutzen, Kosten, Risiken, Aufwand, Lifecycle-Auswirkungen und Standardprodukt-Relevanz.

• Aufbau und Pflege einer realistischen Infrastructure Roadmap inklusive Obsolescence-, Lifecycle-, Bugfix- und Verbesserungsmaßnahmen.

• Moderation technischer Abstimmungen, ohne selbst zwingend Spezialist:in für jedes Detail zu sein.

• Vorbereitung von Make-or-Buy-, Standardprodukt-vs.-Kundenlösung- und Architekturentscheidungen gemeinsam mit den technischen Rollen.

• Koordination von Maßnahmen- und Umsetzungs-Backlogs, Ressourcen, Abhängigkeiten, Budgetbeiträgen und Projektplänen für Infrastruktur- und Plattformthemen.

• Sicherstellung von Transparenz gegenüber dem strategischen Produkt Management, Development, Delivery, Projektleitung und weiteren internen Stakeholdern.

Typische Themen im Infrastructure Umfeld

• Plattform & Betrieb: RHEL, Virtualisierung, Bare Metal vs. Virtualisierung, OpenShift, Kubernetes, Talos Linux, Storage, Netzwerk, High Availability, IdaM

• Automatisierung & Delivery: Ansible, GitOps, Argo CD, Container Registry, Deployment- und Konfigurationsautomatisierung, Backlog- und Release-Koordination

• Security & Daten: PKI, KMS, Security Hardening, Backup & Recovery, Disaster Recovery, Compliance, Data Retention

Qualifikationen

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in technischem Projektmanagement, operativem Produktmanagement, Product Ownership, technischer Koordination oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle im IT-/Infrastrukturumfeld.

• Gutes Verständnis für Infrastruktur- und Plattformthemen: Betriebssysteme, Virtualisierung, Container-Plattformen, Datenbanken, Middleware, Security, Storage, Netzwerk oder Automatisierung.

• Hohe Affinität zu IT-Security.

• Fähigkeit, technische Aussagen einzuordnen und in Entscheidungsoptionen zu übersetzen.

• Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit System Engineers, Software Architects, Delivery-Teams und Projektleiter:innen.

• Praxis mit agilen oder hybriden Arbeitsweisen, Backlog Management, JIRA, Confluence oder vergleichbaren Tools von Vorteil.

• Ausgeprägte Stakeholder-, Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeit.

• Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit Freude an Priorisierung, Klarheit und Umsetzung.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und interkulturelle Kompetenz.

Warum die Rolle spannend ist

• Sie gestalten die infrastrukturelle Basis einer sicherheitskritischen Public-Transport-Lösung mit.

• Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle zwischen Technik, Business und Kundenanforderungen.

• Sie helfen, aus vielen Einzelanforderungen einen belastbaren Standardprodukt-Pfad zu entwickeln.

• Sie schaffen Klarheit in Themen wie Lifecycle, Obsolescence, Security, Automatisierung und Plattformarchitektur.

Unsere Werte

Rund 2.900 Frequentis Mitarbeiter:innen engagieren sich mit ihrer Innovationskraft und Technologieorientierung für eine sichere Welt. Unsere Kultur ist von Fairness und Vertrauen, gegenseitigem Respekt und Wertschätzung geprägt. Als internationales Unternehmen schätzen wir diese Vielfalt und rekrutieren unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Ethnizität, sexueller Orientierung oder Religion. Wir legen Wert auf faire und gute Arbeitsbedingungen, eine optimale Work-Life-Balance und bieten all unseren Mitarbeiter:innen gleiche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dabei setzen wir auf langfristige Arbeitsbeziehungen, um das wertvolle Know-how unserer Mitarbeitenden stabil zu halten.

Die Bezahlung für diese Position besteht aus: Dem kollektivvertraglichen Mindestgehalt von EUR 46.202 brutto pro Jahr (auf Basis einer 38,5 Stunden-Woche) PLUS einer marktkonformen Überzahlung in Abhängigkeit von Ihrer fachlichen Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung. Was ist für Sie noch wichtig? Wir freuen uns auf die Fragen unserer zukünftigen #ExpertsForASaferWorld.

Frequentis Benefits

Bei Frequentis zu arbeiten bedeutet, die Welt jeden Tag sicherer zu machen, langfristige Karrieremöglichkeiten zu haben und von zahlreichen Benefits zu profitieren. Dazu zählen unter anderem ein Arbeitszeitmodell, das auf Vertrauen basiert, die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten, die Auswahl von IT-Equipment, ein Öffi-Ticket für Wien oder ein Parkplatz nach Verfügbarkeit, unser Lunch Bonus im Office, die Möglichkeit eines Sabbaticals, ein umfassendes Onboarding-Programm und zahlreiche Programme zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterbildung. System Solution Engineer - Optical Interconnect CMOS ICs for Datacom (d/​m/​f)

Sense the power of light

The ams OSRAM Group is a global leader in innovative light and sensor solutions. With more than 110 years of industry experience, we combineengineering excellence and global manufacturing with a passion for cutting-edge innovation enabling transformative advancements in theautomotive, industrial, medical, and consumer industries. "Sense the power of light" - our success is based on the deep understanding of thepotential of light and distinct portfolio of emitter and sensor technologies. Around 19,700 employees worldwide drive innovations alongside societalmegatrends.
 Find out more about us on https://ams-osram.com

 The CSA division supplies sensors that bridge the gap between the world we live in and the digital world of machines. By converting physical signals- heartbeats, sounds, light waves - into data, we enable robots, cars and other devices to interact with people and improve our world. What drivesCSA is a relentless desire to contribute to technology and have a meaningful impact on the world. This business thrives on solving complexproblems and partnering with global leaders at the forefront of technological advancement. Our goal: to push the boundaries of sensor technologyand empower innovators to make the world smarter, healthier and happier.

Your new responsibilities

Join us in Premstätten, Regensburg, Pavia or Eindhoven and help define the future of optical connectivity for AI and data centers:

• Translate customer architectures and application requirements into differentiated Integrated Circuit (IC) product concepts and roadmaps

• Act as the technical voice of the customer across Product Management, R&D and Marketing

• Engage directly with hyperscalers, networking companies, optical module suppliers and ecosystem partners

• Drive the CMOS system architecture definition in the context of optics, photonics, mixed-signal ICs and packaging

• Analyze market trends, competing technologies and emerging optical interconnect architectures

• Identify CMOS IC technology gaps and recommend strategic investments for future product differentiation

• Support technical design-ins, customer evaluations and design-win activities worldwide

• Develop application notes, white papers, technical presentations and customer enablement materials

• Represent ams OSRAM at customer workshops, technical conferences and industry events

Who we are looking for

• Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Photonics or Physics

• Proven experience with mixed-signal CMOS, photodiodes, analog front-ends, drivers, TIAs or SerDes

• Extensive industry experience in datacom, networking or optical interconnects

• Solid understanding of datacenter (optical) links, transceivers and architectures

• Strong system-level thinking across optics, electronics, packaging and integration

• Experience working directly with customers on complex technical challenges

• Ability to translate market needs into differentiated semiconductor solutions

• Excellent English communication skills; German is a plus

For Austria: We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry,employment group H (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/).
 We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.

Senior Staff Engineer Process Integration for Wide Bandgap Power Technologies (w/m/div)

#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. Help us shape the foundation that keeps Infineon's production running - stable, safe, and ready for the future. As a Senior Staff Engineer Process Integration for Wide Bandgap Power Technologies in our Manufacturing and Operations team, your contribution ensures that innovation never stands still. Together, we make reliability our strongest asset. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

• Apply advanced statistical methods and AI applications to support technology stabilization, yield improvement, and cost optimization across the global process chain

• Act as the Front-End representative for the development of WBG power technologies, collaborating closely with development and transfer teams

• Drive and manage actions resulting from technology ramp-up activities following the official production release

• Take full ownership of yield planning and ensure continuous yield monitoring to meet performance targets

• Lead and participate in root cause analysis teams to define sustainable corrective and preventive actions for process deviations

• Sustain and optimize high-volume production by contributing expert know-how on process and equipment capabilities in collaboration with global partner fabs

• Execute release and delivery decisions for production goods in strict alignment with established quality and production standards

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

• A Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or a comparable technical field

• Several years of professional experience in semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on technology development, process, or yield engineering

• Technical expertise in Silicon or WBG technologies (SiC/GaN) and experience supporting technology ramp-ups in high-volume environments

• Advanced skills in statistical data analysis (SPC, DOE) and the application of AI/Machine Learning for process optimization

• A structured and analytical mindset with a proven ability to drive complex topics independently from analysis to implementation

• Excellent communication and interface skills to collaborate effectively across global production, quality, and development teams

• Fluency in English is required, with German language skills being a distinct advantage in our international environment

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.

title: Data Center Mechanical Engineer
description_full:
About the job
 Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department -- cutting-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements -- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians.

As the Data Center Mechanical Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical support of the localized design effort (Campus Plan through to Detailed Design), for field engineering support through project delivery and commissioning, and for engineering reviews of the close-out documentation. In addition, and depending on the Campus activities, you will support the mechanical design and delivery of Moves, Adds, Retrofits, Changes, Upgrades, and Security projects (MARCUS) within operational data centers. You will liaise with the Data Center Operations team on all mechanical warranty issues.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Data Center Mechanical Engineer

Google | Kronstorf, Austria | Mid

Responsibilities

• Drive project mechanical outcomes of high complexity and scope as a key contributor, integrating feedback from multiple stakeholders when necessary.

• Contribute to project mechanical scoping and direction, and manage project mechanical priorities and allocation of technical resources within the project.

• Provide technical leadership to the projects, support and optimize project design, scope, schedule, quality, commissioning, and safety for mechanical discipline. Provide feedback to the central partner teams on possible improvements.

• Troubleshoot advanced mechanical system events, escalate only the issues as appropriate. Contribute to the development of cross-project, cross-functional, and cross-organizational procedures and ensure alignment of the Mechanical Engineer's work with multiple teams/projects.

• Support interactions with the authorities, searching for possible solutions on inspections deficiencies, third-party inspection agreements, and advance statements/instructions from the authorities' correction requests.

Requirements

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience managing construction projects within an international working environment.

• Experience in facility mechanical systems.

• Experience working with data center equipment/environments including switchgear, generators, controls, security monitoring systems, and fire safety systems.

Preferred qualifications:

• Understanding of start up/commissioning processes.

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

description_snippet: Vollzeit Media Channels Automation & AI Specialist Elsbethen, Österreich Apply now Make a real impact by improving how media marketing gets done across Red Bull's global network...
description_full:
Vollzeit

Media Channels Automation & AI Specialist

Elsbethen, Österreich

Apply now

Make a real impact by improving how media marketing gets done across Red Bull's global network.

As part of our Global Program Strategy team, you'll play a key role in improving how the teams around the world work in Airtable. You embed with Red Bull Media Network teams in international markets and optimize how they brief, plan, and distribute media across communications, content, media channels, and partnerships.

This is a fixed‑term position for 12 months.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Areas that play to your strengths

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

IN A NUTSHELL

Your focus is simple: make work better. You create fast, pragmatic solutions that save time and improve outcomes. This might involve automation, smarter use of existing tools, or applying modern technologies such as AI; always choosing the approach that delivers the most value with the least complexity.

You operate at the edge of our technology landscape, inside business teams. Rather than building large-scale systems, you focus on local improvements within your domain and on quick wins that have an immediate impact. At the same time, you understand the broader ecosystem and collaborate closely with IT and product teams to ensure your solutions align with existing platforms and scale when needed.

RESEARCH & DESIGN WITH THE USERS

Spend time speaking with colleagues from the Global Headquarters as well as our international teams about their media planning workflows. Learn how they brief, plan, and deliver work. Identify the parts of the job where you can truly help them save time or amplify the outcome. Create solutions (also considering agents and skills) around the work each department is actually doing. Make something useful on a project your colleagues are shipping now, not a concept for the next quarter; with them, in real time.

MATCH THE CRAFT

The teams you assist have strong creative standards. You know what good looks like, you can build to it, and you support the users by operating the solutions. Design standards count as much as the engineering and the customer support.

SCALE WHAT WORKS

Document your wins, how it works, and how to use it, so other teams know what's available and you can help them plug in easily. You collaborate with IT for scaling beyond local solutions where needed.

INCREASE VALUE

As the central planning system contains crucial data for all subsequent steps in the process, you enable additional operational workflows on top of it and therefore increase the value of the central system - in close alignment with IT and Data Governance.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

You collaborate not just with users but also with other service providers within the organization to design impactful solutions within the corporate guardrails.

Experience

Your areas of knowledge and expertise

That matter most for this role:

• 3+ years of experience in user research, analytical problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Experience with large language models, automation, APIs, basic data structures as well as with low-code or no-code platforms (e.g. Airtable).

• Hands-on track record of building tools (ideally with Python), AI-powered workflows, agents, or automations that improve real work.

• Good understanding of data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements such as GDPR and the EU AI Act.

• Proactive, action-oriented, and comfortable working with ambiguity across teams with different levels of technical and AI maturity.

• Fluent in English, German or other languages are a plus

• 0-10

JOIN THE TEAM

Got what it takes?

In your application we want to see your personal style - what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Apply now

title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer - Cybersecurity Focus (m/f/d)
description_snippet: Human progress is powered by smart machines, smart machines are powered by human visions As machines are becoming smarter, performance, safety and reliability have never been more important...
description_full:
Human progress is powered by smart machines - smart machines are powered by human visions

As machines are becoming smarter - performance, safety and reliability have never been more important. We provide these attributes for millions of mobile machines worldwide, right here in the heart of Europe. If you come work with TTControl in Vienna, your visions will be on board, too.

Senior Embedded Linux Engineer - Cybersecurity Focus (m/f/d)

In this role, you will combine your deep expertise in embedded Linux with a focus on cybersecurity to develop robust, future-proof software platforms for our high-performance integrated display (operator panel) and computing platforms. You will work across the full stack of embedded Linux, from hardware bring-up and low-level components to performance optimization and system hardening. Applying secure-by-design principles and modern toolchains, you will help deliver robust and resilient embedded solutions. As part of a collaborative and forward‑thinking team, you will contribute to building secure smart machine technologies while continuously learning and exploring new advancements in the field.

Your Tasks

• Design, develop, and maintain embedded Linux distributions for ARM-based platforms, covering the full software stack from hardware bring-up to system-level integration

• Own and continuously evolve core system components, including bootloader, Linux kernel, device drivers, system libraries, and utilities

• Optimize system performance (e.g., boot time, CPU utilization, memory footprint) for real-world industrial applications

• Lead hardware bring-up and commissioning in close collaboration with electronics and hardware teams

• Maintain and enhance build and integration environments, particularly within Yocto-based systems

• Design, implement, and maintain security features (e.g., secure boot, filesystem encryption, access control) and ensure system hardening across the Linux stack

• Identify, analyze, and mitigate vulnerabilities (kernel, drivers, and user space), including integration of security updates, patches, and CVE fixes

• Promote and apply secure‑by‑design principles to strengthen system resilience against modern cyber threats

• Contribute to team collaboration, including knowledge sharing and mentoring of less experienced colleagues

Your Profile

• Degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related technical field (TU/FH or equivalent)

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in embedded Linux development on ARM-based platforms

• Strong programming skills in C; C++ is a plus

• Solid experience with embedded Linux technologies and tools (e.g., U‑Boot, Linux Kernel, Yocto, Git), ideally in Automotive or Off‑Highway environments

• Strong understanding of Linux system architecture and security concepts, including secure boot, access control, and system hardening

• Good knowledge of secure software development principles (secure-by-design mindset)

• Experience with modern AI-based tools to support development, analysis, or productivity is a plus

• Collaborative team player with strong communication skills, curiosity, and a continuous learning mindset

• Very good command of English; German is a plus

Our Offer

• Exciting work environment - be part of future high-tech innovations and cutting-edge technologies

• We are a team - flat hierarchies, open door policy, communication at eye level and hands-on mentality

• Technical Expertise - work among fellow technical experts and minds that will inspire you

• Central locations - our offices are located in the city center near Karlsplatz & Kettenbrückengasse, easily accessible via public transport and bicycle

• Benefits Package - lunch tickets, job tickets (unlimited use of public transport in Vienna or partially reimbursement of costs for KlimaTicket, numerous discounts, events and much more

• Work-life-balance - additional days off, home office, workcation (up to 45 workdays per year Mobile Working within the EU) and individual working time models

As of today, TTTECH Group employs more than 1,100 people in 11 locations worldwide. Join our pioneering team and become part of our fascinating projects. You will find it #mindgrowing

We provide an attractive and performance-based salary, which is based on your qualifications and professional experience. This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for Employees in the Metal Trade ("Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte Metallgewerbe") and we offer a minimum salary of EUR 65,000 gross per year. Actual compensation can be well above this standard.
