description_full:
Business Continuity & Resilience Manager

The Business Continuity & Resilience Manager establishes, operates, and continuously improves INNIO's Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) to ensure that critical business services can withstand and recover from disruption. The role emphasizes a pragmatic, standards‑aligned approach (ISO 22301/BSI 200‑4/NIS2), prioritizing BIAs and continuity strategies at the products & services / critical function level, and strong interlocks with Information Security, Crisis Management, and Supplier/Vendor Management.

At INNIO we offer you:

• An innovative and international working environment

• Remote & flexible working time model

• Health We Care Program - including company sport activities

• Moving cost support for new employees in accordance with policy

• Good connections to public transport - station in direct proximity

• Transportation cost support in accordance with policy

• One of the best canteens in the area with healthy and various meals

• Attractive location in the heart of the alps which provides various outdoor sport and other leisure possibilities

Your Responsibilities:

• BCMS Governance & Framework: Build and operate a BCMS aligned to ISO 22301, BSI 200‑4, and NIS2; integrate with Information Security and enterprise risk management; maintain policy, standards, templates, and management reviews.

• Business Impact & Risk: Plan and conduct BIAs and BCM risk assessments prioritized at the products & services / critical function level; define RTO/RPO and recovery priorities; translate results into feasible continuity strategies and investment proposals.

• Continuity & Emergency Plans: Develop and maintain continuity and emergency plans across IT and business; include communications, manual workarounds, invocation and stand‑down criteria; ensure approvals per CISO governance.

• Exercises, Testing & Assurance: Design and run an annual exercise program (table‑tops to simulations); track corrective actions through closure; prepare evidence for internal/external audits and regulatory reviews.

• Supplier Continuity (optional scope extension): Define continuity and security requirements for critical suppliers; evaluate supplier resilience; embed BCM clauses and fallback strategies; integrate key suppliers into exercises with Procurement and Legal.

• Awareness, Training & Culture: Train service/process owners and crisis roles; promote participation in drills; provide dashboards and briefings to leadership on readiness, risks, and improvements.

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's degree in business, Risk, Engineering, IT, or comparable experience.

• Proven experience in BCM/resilience; manufacturing/industrial context preferred.

• Certifications preferred: ISO 22301 Practitioner/Lead Implementer, CBCP or equivalent.

• Familiarity with EU regulatory context (e.g., NIS2) and implications for BCM & Information Security.

• Strong stakeholder leadership and facilitation skills (BIAs, exercises, crisis decision framing).

• Analytical skills to convert impact/risk data into strategies, investments, and measurable outcomes.

• Excellent written and verbal communication (DE/EN); concise plan writing and leadership updates.

At INNIO, we offer a competitive salary package which is far above the requirements of the metal collective agreement in Austria. We highly value your individual qualifications and experience. As part of our recruiting process, we engage in open dialogue with you to discuss the details and ensure the best possible fit.

Interested?
 Please apply via: innio.com/en/careers

Business & Data Analytics Project Specialist (f/m/d)

Ihre Rolle: Übernehmen Sie die Herausforderung

In dieser neu geschaffenen Position als Projektspezialist für Business & Data Analytics arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Wirtschaft, Daten und Technologie und unterstützen unser Unternehmen dabei, komplexe Geschäftsfragen in strukturierte und aussagekräftige Lösungen zu verwandeln. Sie arbeiten eng mit Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen zusammen, verstehen deren Bedürfnisse, überprüfen bestehende Ansätze und helfen bei der Definition der richtigen Prioritäten, KPIs und Reporting-Lösungen.

Sie übernehmen ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Sichtbarkeit und arbeiten eng mit Führungskräften und technischen Experten zusammen, um Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur Implementierung zu gestalten und zu steuern.

In dieser Rolle helfen Sie dabei, das am Laufen zu halten, was die Welt bewegt - mit sinnstiftender Arbeit, die echten Impact schafft.

Das Arbeitsmodell für diese Position ist: vor Ort mit bis zu 10 Homeoffice-Tagen pro Monat.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den relevanten Geschäftsbereichen, um deren Bedürfnisse zu verstehen, Anfragen zu strukturieren und in klare Prioritäten, KPIs und konkrete Handlungsanweisungen zu übersetzen.

• Analyse bestehender Organisations- und Berichtsstrukturen, Identifizierung von Verbesserungspotenzialen und Entwicklung praxisorientierter Lösungen gemeinsam mit den Geschäftsbereichen.

• Projektmanagement von der ersten Idee bis zur Implementierung, einschließlich der Definition von Zielen, Meilensteinen, Governance und Erfolgskennzahlen.

• Als Sparringspartner für Stakeholder im gesamten Unternehmen fungieren und dabei Geschäftsverständnis, analytisches Denken und einen strukturierten Entscheidungsprozess einbringen.

So ticken unsere Teams
 Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, arbeiten eng zusammen und hören nie auf zu lernen. Jede*r bringt etwas Einzigartiges mit - und gemeinsam treiben wir Ideen voran, um echte Herausforderungen zu lösen. Teil unseres Teams zu sein bedeutet: Ihre Arbeit zählt. Denn der Fortschritt, den wir hier machen, hat echten Impact da draußen."

Ihre Qualifikationen für eine Rolle, die bewegt

• Sie verfügen über 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Business Analytics, Projektmanagement, Beratung, Controlling, datengetriebene Geschäftsfunktionen oder einem ähnlichen Feld.

• Sie haben ein Studium in einem relevanten Fachgebiet wie Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Informatik, Datenanalyse, Ingenieurwesen oder Wirtschaftsinformatik abgeschlossen; vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung ist ebenfalls willkommen.

• Sie arbeiten gerne mit Menschen zusammen und können sich souverän mit Stakeholdern auf verschiedenen Ebenen, einschließlich des Top-Managements, austauschen.

• Sie verbinden analytisches Denken mit strategischem Weitblick und können komplexe oder unklare Fragestellungen in strukturierte Vorgehensweisen und klare Prioritäten umwandeln.

• Sie sind findig und neugierig und bereit, zuzuhören, Fragen zu stellen, das Unternehmen kennenzulernen und bestehende Arbeitsweisen zu verbessern.

• Erfahrung mit Power BI, SAP oder anderen Reporting- und Datentools; idealerweise auch Erfahrung mit Plattformen wie Snowflake oder Salesforce.

• Sie fühlen sich in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld bei ABB wohl und kommunizieren sicher in Deutsch und Englisch, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.

Was Ihre Zukunft bei uns besonders macht?

• Work-Life Balance - Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, einschließlich Gleitzeit und hybrider Optionen, um Ihr persönliches und berufliches Leben bestmöglich zu vereinen.

• Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden - Zugang zu verschiedenen Gesundheitsmaßnahmen, unserem Global Employee Assistance Program (Mitarbeiterunterstützungsprogramm) und einer geschlechtsneutralen Elternzeitregelung.

• Finanzielle Vergünstigungen - Teilnahme am Global Employee Shareholder Acquisition Program (ESAP) und Essenszuschuss.

description_full:
RailNetEurope (RNE) is an association of European Infrastructure Managers (IMs) and Allocation Bodies (Abs) headquartered in Vienna. With around 80 international employees, we actively shape the future of European rail transport. Through innovative processes and IT solutions, we drive the digitalization and efficiency of European capacity management in view of the upcoming requirements from EU legislation.

We are looking for a Business Analyst with a strong technical mindset to design and shape digital solutions for European rail capacity management. You will work at the intersection of business processes, software architecture, and system integrations, translating complex business needs into clear functional requirements and technically feasible solutions while collaborating closely with architects, developers, testers, and stakeholders.

Business Analyst

Full time 40h/week

YOUR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements, workflows, and user needs.

• Translate business requirements into user stories and functional specifications.

• Analyse processes and identify opportunities for workflow and system improvements.

• Collaborate with business, development, testing, and design teams throughout the project lifecycle.

• Work with technical experts on railway system interfaces and interoperability

• Create process diagrams, documentation, and other project deliverables.

• Ensure railway-compliant solutions through validation, testing and requirements traceability

• Support onboarding activities and deliver training sessions for users and stakeholders.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

• 3+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Requirements Engineering, or a related field.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and process modelling skills with attention to detail.

• Fluent working knowledge of English; additional EU languages are an advantage.

• Ability to document business processes and functional requirements clearly.

• Experience working with cross-functional teams in software delivery projects.

• Familiarity with DCM systems and sector requirements (e.g. Telematics TSI) is an advantage.

WHAT WE OFFER

• Opportunity to work on unique projects in an innovative environment.

• Flexible working hours with the option of up to 50% home office.

• Modern office in an international environment with a high-energy, driven teams.

• Individual development opportunities in a supportive working environment.

The annual gross minimum wage for this is EUR 50.000, - (full time - 40h/week), willingness to offer above-market salary depending on experience and qualifications.

title: Social Media, Alumni & Communications Specialist
description_full:
Are you looking to thrive in a dynamic role within one of Europe's most unique international schools? St. Gilgen International School (StGIS) is seeking a creative and driven individual to join our team. If you have strong communication skills and a knack for creatively expressing our school's identity, we want to hear from you.

Social Media, Alumni & Communications Specialist

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and manage the organic digital media plan that strengthens the school's online presence, supports admissions priorities and builds alumni engagement, within the wider marketing strategy set by the Austrian Marketing Manager.

• Own and coordinate an integrated content calendar across social media, the website, newsletters and alumni communications, and publish and engage across Meta (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube -- responding to routine community engagement and escalating sensitive or reputational issues as appropriate.

• Create high-quality multimedia content -- photography, short-form video, interviews and written stories -- that showcases everyday school life, student achievements, academic, boarding and co-curricular programmes, outdoor education, wellbeing and school events.

• Identify and write authentic community stories, school news, interviews and thought-leadership pieces, and supply content assets for paid campaigns and for agent and parent communications.

• Write, coordinate and upload routine news and approved website content, and help identify website content gaps (technical website changes and builds sit with the Cognita Web Team).

• Plan, build and distribute school newsletters, maintain recipient lists and review newsletter performance.

• Manage the alumni database, profiles and stories, and support the annual alumni engagement plan, the relationship with the Alumni Association, alumni referral and advocacy activity and fundraising-related communications, in collaboration with the IB Coordinator, Marketing, Admissions and school teams.

• Support recruitment and school events with collateral and presentations, on-site photography and social coverage, event promotion and follow-up, and event logistics and family attendance.

• Produce agent newsletters, presentations and marketing materials, and help coordinate agent webinars and presentations.

• Apply and maintain StGIS and Cognita brand standards and templates -- internal posters, email signatures, Word and PowerPoint templates, branded signage (with Facilities) and school brochures -- and brief designers and production suppliers as required.

• Curate and maintain an organised digital asset library, using Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva or comparable tools and ensuring consistent brand identity, tone of voice and visual standards.

• Monitor organic reach, engagement and content performance, prepare regular insights and support the weekly StGIS marketing commentary; monitor local competitor activity and gather parent, alumni and community insight (including the Voice of Parent survey).

• Ensure photography, video, website, newsletter and alumni activity complies with GDPR, safeguarding, image-consent and school privacy requirements, and apply brand and privacy standards to content production.

Skills

Required Skills:

• Relevant experience in social media management, content creation, digital communications or community engagement.

• Proven ability to build audiences and drive engagement through organic content on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German, with copywriting, editing and proofreading ability.

• Confident photography, videography and short-form video editing skills, with a strong understanding of visual storytelling.

• Comfortable creating and updating website content in a CMS (e.g. WordPress) and planning, building and sending newsletters using email-marketing tools.

• Good working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects), Canva or similar creative tools, as well as Microsoft 365.

• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage a content calendar, prioritise deadlines and respond flexibly to school life and events.

• Independent, proactive and collaborative working style, with sound judgement, discretion and sensitivity when working with students, staff, parents and alumni.

• Willingness to learn, test new formats and adapt to developments in digital communication, analytics and responsible AI-supported content workflows.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience with CRM systems and alumni or database management, and with event or fundraising support.

• Working knowledge of Adobe InDesign and Illustrator, or comparable tools, for brochures, templates and print materials.

• Basic understanding of SEO/GEO, Google Analytics (GA4), platform analytics and performance reporting.

• Experience in education, international schools, alumni relations, agent communications, events or fundraising support.

• Familiarity with applying brand guidelines and briefing designers or print suppliers.

• Ability to support occasional event coverage outside standard office hours when required.

• Awareness of safeguarding, image-consent and data-protection (GDPR) requirements in school communications.

Offer

• Flexible work arrangement, where compatible with content creation, event coverage and on-campus responsibilities.

• Complete induction programme​

• Opportunities for various training courses (first aid, etc.)​

• Discounted lunch (excluding school holidays) during working hours​

• Use of school facilities subject to availability and agreement​

• Free fruits and coffee​

• Public holidays and weekends off, except for 2-3 school events per school year​

• International team of colleagues​

• Overpayment depending on qualifications​

Overtime

Any accrued overtime is compensated in the form of time off.

To apply for this exciting role, please send your CV, cover letter, earliest possible start date and, where available, a portfolio or examples of previous social media, photography, video or written content work via smart apply.

Join us at StGIS, where you can contribute to a thriving school community while advancing your career in digital media and content creation.

MORE ABOUT VIG

Your Tasks

As Group Third Party Risk Manager (m/f/d), you will coordinate and support the operational implementation of the Group-wide Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework. You will ensure that risks arising from relationships with third-party service providers are identified, assessed, documented, and monitored in accordance with consistent Group-wide standards.

In this role, you will work closely with local Group entities as well as Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Data Protection, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit. You will coordinate Group-wide third-party risk assessments, support compliance with regulatory requirements--particularly those related to the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA)--and contribute to the consistent implementation of TPRM processes across the organization.

Third Party Risk Management

• Coordinate and perform Third Party Risk Assessments for critical and important third-party service providers.

• Manage the third-party risk management process throughout the entire vendor lifecycle--from onboarding risk assessments and periodic reassessments to the termination of business relationships.

• Conduct and document risk-based due diligence reviews and validate assessment results.

• Ensure the timely completion of risk assessments, periodic reviews, and control activities.

• Track identified risks, audit findings, and agreed remediation actions through to completion.

• Maintain and ensure the quality of Group-wide TPRM documentation, registers, and relevant data repositories.

• Coordinate with local Group entities on operational Third Party Risk Management matters.

Regulatory Compliance & DORA

• Implement regulatory requirements related to Third Party Risk Management, with a particular focus on the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and other applicable outsourcing and third-party risk regulations.

• Perform regulatory risk assessments and ensure appropriate documentation of results.

• Coordinate the preparation of evidence and documentation required for internal and external audits as well as regulatory inspections.

• Conduct gap analyses and monitor the implementation of regulatory remediation measures.

• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of necessary changes to operational TPRM processes.

Collaboration & Reporting

• Collaborate closely with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Data Protection, Operational Risk Management, Business Continuity Management, and local Group entities.

• Coordinate information exchange among stakeholders throughout the third-party risk management process.

• Support the preparation of regular management reports, key risk indicators (KRIs), metrics, and status updates.

• Assist in preparing decision-making materials for governance bodies, management, and risk committees.

• Contribute to Group-wide initiatives aimed at enhancing Third Party Risk Management and Operational Resilience.

Process & Quality Management

• Support the continuous improvement of operational TPRM processes, methodologies, and workflows in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.

• Perform quality assurance activities to ensure the consistent application of TPRM processes across the Group.

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of process documentation, work instructions, and standard templates.

• Support the implementation and optimization of TPRM and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) systems.

• Deliver training sessions and awareness initiatives on TPRM processes and regulatory requirements.

Your Benefits

• 38,5 Working Hours, Flexi Time & Home-Office

• Learning & Development

• Life Balance & Family Specials

• Modern Workspace & Canteen

• Health & Sports Offers

• More Benefits

Your Profile

Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Law, Business Law, Risk Management, or a related field.

• Professional experience in Third Party Risk Management, Operational Risk Management, Outsourcing Management, Internal Audit, Compliance, or Legal, ideally within the insurance or financial services sector.

• Experience conducting risk assessments, audits, due diligence reviews, or regulatory assessments.

• Strong knowledge of financial sector regulations, particularly DORA, Solvency II, EIOPA Outsourcing Guidelines, as well as relevant data protection and outsourcing requirements.

• Strong analytical skills with a structured, proactive, and independent working style.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively in an international corporate environment.

• Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional experience within an international insurance group or financial institution.

• Background in Internal or External Audit, Risk Management, Compliance, or Business Law.

• Knowledge of Information Security, Data Protection, or Business Continuity Management.

• Experience with GRC or TPRM platforms such as ServiceNow, RSA Archer, OneTrust, or comparable solutions.

• Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISA, CIA, or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage.

The annual gross salary (full-time) for the position is at least EUR 56.224,00. Do you have extensive experience and expertise? If so, we're happy to offer a salary above this amount in recognition of your qualifications.

Lead Financial Analyst - Engineering (m/f/d)

INNIO Group is a global distributed energy solutions provider that delivers reliable, flexible, transient, decentralized, modular and efficient power. With a track record of innovation, INNIO designs, manufactures and services high‑performance power systems under its Jenbacher and Waukesha brands. The company delivers power for applications including data centers, microgrids, grid stabilization, industrial energy and gas compression.

The Lead Financial Analyst - Engineering (m/f/d) is a key Finance partner to the Engineering and Digital departments, providing financial oversight and driving performance transparency across the INNIO Group.

This role is to be filled in Jenbach in Tyrol, Austria. At INNIO we offer you:

• An innovative and international working environment

• Flexible working time model (depending on position and role)

• Health We Care Program - including company sport activities

• Moving cost support for new employees in accordance with policy

• Good connections to public transport - station in direct proximity

• Transportation cost support in accordance with policy

• One of the best canteens in the area with healthy and various meals

• Attractive location in the heart of the alps which provides various outdoor sport and other leisure possibilities

Essential Responsibilities:

• Own the Engineering/Digital financial closing process, including preparation and posting of manual journal entries, accruals and reclasses where required, as well as validation of actuals, cost allocations and capitalization logic, ensuring accuracy and compliance with Group Controlling standards.

• Lead Engineering/Digital forecasting and budgeting cycles, including coordination with Engineering, Digital, Group FP&A and other Finance controlling teams, validation of planning assumptions, and timely submission of data into the relevant financial planning systems.

• Independently assess financial performance, distinguish most likely versus best-case scenarios, and proactively highlight financial risks, opportunities and constraints to support informed decision-making.

• Act as a hands-on and independent Finance counterpart to Engineering/Digital leadership, providing fact-based challenge, financial transparency and decision-oriented recommendations.

• Partner with Engineering and Digital stakeholders to identify cost optimization opportunities, link financial results to operational drivers and influence decision-making through structured financial analysis.

• Perform financial validation of Engineering/Digital R&D programs and provide guidance on cost capitalization criteria according to US GAAP and IFRS (OPEX vs CAPEX).

• Support the annual funding request submission of INNIO's R&D programs to the Austrian state authorities, including FFG-related processes.

• Support BI redesign for Engineering/Digital KPIs to enable transparency, flexibility, sustainability, deeper analysis and efficient reporting solutions.

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's/master's degree in accounting/finance/economics/business administration.

• Several years of relevant professional experience in controlling and accounting, ideally within an industrial or technology-driven environment.

• Strong analytic skills: able to clearly link financial results to operational performance drivers, generate alternatives and drive positive change.

• Excellent communication skills and assertiveness: experience working across multiple levels and functions; clearly communicate complex financial information.

• Strong MS-Office skills: experience with financial systems/applications, strong Excel skills.

• Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with recurring peak periods during closing and planning cycles.

At INNIO, we offer a competitive salary package which is far above the requirements of the metal collective agreement in Austria. We highly value your individual qualifications and experience. As part of our recruiting process, we engage in open dialogue with you to discuss the details and ensure the best possible fit.

title: Advanced Data Analyst – Data & AI (m/f/d)

description_full:
Advanced Data Analyst - Data & AI (m/f/d)

As a Data Analyst with focus for Data & AI at INNIO, you will drive and support the development, implementation, and improvement of INNIO's data-driven management steering approach. This includes the analysis of large data sets to derive actionable insights, identify trends, define KPIs and develop sustainable data solutions that support the company's strategy. At the very heart of this steering approach is the building and continuous development of sustainable data products and analytical foundations, enabling a holistic 360-degree view to answer the key questions: 'what has happened and why' and 'what will happen' and 'how can it be actively influenced'.

What INNIO offers you:

• An innovative and international working environment

• Flexible working time model (depending on position and role)

• Health We Care program - including company sports activities

• Moving cost support for new employees in accordance with policy

• Good connections to public transport - station in direct proximity

• Transportation cost support in accordance with policy

• One of the best canteens in the area with healthy and various meals

• Attractive location in the heart of the Alps with various outdoor sports and leisure possibilities

Your Responsibilities

• Execute data analyses on large and diverse datasets to answer complex business questions and identify trends, patterns, and relationships.

• Identify relevant data sources, data quality issues, process gaps, and dependencies, and understand how data is generated, structured, connected, and used across INNIO's data products.

• Translate business questions and requirements into analytical concepts, data requirements, metrics, and data-driven solutions.

• Develop proof-of-concepts to validate analytical approaches and potential solutions and provide the basis for further technical implementation.

• Interpret and translate analytical results into actionable insights, clear conclusions, and recommendations to support data-driven decision-making.

• Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs, clarify requirements, and challenge assumptions where appropriate to ensure the right business problem is being addressed.

• Collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to connect analytical concepts with the further development of data products, reports, and dashboards.

Your Profile

• Completed university studies in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Business & Administration, or a related field.

• 3+ years of professional experience in data analytics or a related analytical field.

• Strong hands-on experience with Python and SQL and the analysis of large and complex datasets. Knowledge in Databricks is a plus.

• Strong technical understanding of how data is generated, structured, connected, and processed.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and challenge assumptions.

• Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required. German is a plus.

• This role requires 50% presence in Jenbach, Austria

• A valid work permit for Austria is a prerequisite for this position (Non-EU citizens: please attach the work permit to the application)

At INNIO, we offer an attractive compensation package that is above the collective agreement for the metal industry. Your qualifications and experience will be considered in an open dialogue during the recruiting process to ensure a market-competitive compensation package.

Interested?
 Please apply via: innio.com/en/careers

We are responsible for Cyber & Information Security Governance across Erste Group Bank AG and its local and international subsidiaries, helping to ensure a consistent and effective security framework throughout the organization. Our team works closely with stakeholders across the Group to support governance processes, risk management, regulatory compliance, and security reporting. We continuously improve cybersecurity operations by enhancing data quality, streamlining workflows, and implementing scalable automation solutions. Through innovation, collaboration, and the use of modern technologies, including secure AI-assisted workflows, we help strengthen the Group's cybersecurity capabilities and resilience.

Your Tasks

• Develop and maintain simple automation workflows for cyber security teams using e.g.
 Power Automate and related Microsoft Power Platform components.

• Create and improve Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations for security governance, control monitoring, and management reporting.

• Support the automation of recurring cyber security processes such as evidence collection, task tracking, reporting cycles, data preparation, and stakeholder follow-ups.

• Use basic Python scripts, connectors, APIs, and structured data formats such as Excel, CSV, and JSON to support data processing and integration tasks.

• Help design controlled AI-assisted workflows, including prompt templates and structured outputs, using approved tools such as ChatGPT or equivalent enterprise AI services.

• Collaborate with security governance colleagues, engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into implementation steps.

• Document created solutions, test automations, support handover, and contribute to continuous improvement of cyber security processes.

• Analyze existing data-quality and end-to-end processes, identity opportunities to streamline and optimize.

Your Background

• Ongoing studies at a University or University of Applied Sciences, preferably with a background in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Cyber Security, or a comparable field.

• Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, especially Power BI and Power Automate. Power Apps, Dataverse, and connectors are a plus.

• Hands-on knowledge of Python and willingness to use it for practical automation, data preparation, or integration tasks.

• Familiarity with data analytics, IT environments and architecture, versioning tools (such as GIT/SVN/BitBucket), data processing, reporting, and dashboard design.

• Interest in cyber security, security governance, risk management, or operational security workflows.

• Understanding of AI prompt usage and willingness to work with AI-assisted automation in a secure and compliant way.

• Good understanding of requirements and ability to translate them into clear, practical implementation steps.

• Good communication skills in English to support local and international cooperation. German is a plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured working style.

Our Offer

• Start as soon as possible and work 25 hours per week for 12 months.

• Possibility to benefit and learn from our international, talented and passionate community at Erste.

• Great learning curve through ownership and creative freedom.

• Support of your professional and personal development in a dynamic, comprehensive and interesting are.

• Discover and enjoy the benefits of Erste Group.

• Salary for your internship: EUR2,745.32 gross per month based on full-time employment (excluding mandatory FH internships).

• We offer our employees the opportunity to divide their hours between working from home and at the office.

• We consider the diversity of our employees as key to innovation and success. As employer we are proud to offer everyone equal chances, irrespective of age, skin colour, religious belief, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

title: Data & AI Platform Architect
description_snippet: Ihre Aufgaben: In denen etwas bewegt werden kann: SYSTEM DESIGN & ARCHITEKTURMANAGEMENT Als Data & AI Platform Architect verantwortest du die Architektur, das Design und die Implementierung skalierbarer und...
description_full:
Vollzeit

Data & AI Platform Architect

Elsbethen, Österreich

Bewerben

Bist du bereit, die KI- und Analytics-IT-Landschaft von morgen zu gestalten?
 Als Data & AI Platform Architect übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem globalen IT-Team und gestaltest innovative KI- und Data-Engineering-Lösungen mit echtem Impact. In dieser Position konzipierst und entwickelst du zukunftsweisende Plattformen und Architekturen für den Bereich Teamsport, etwa für den EHC Red Bull München, sowie für viele weitere Non-Beverage-Geschäftsbereiche von Red Bull.

Als Data & AI Platform Architect bist du der technische Sparringspartner für diese Lösungen und eine treibende Kraft für leistungsstarke KI- und Data-Engineering-Services. Wenn du Technologie nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv vorantreiben möchtest, wenn du komplexe Herausforderungen liebst und Lösungen schaffen willst, die einen Unterschied machen, dann könnte das deine nächste Herausforderung sein.

DIE ROLLE

Persönliche Stärken einsetzen

Verantwortungsbereiche und Aufgaben, in denen etwas bewegt werden kann:

SYSTEM DESIGN & ARCHITEKTURMANAGEMENT

Als Data & AI Platform Architect verantwortest du die Architektur, das Design und die Implementierung skalierbarer und leistungsfähiger KI- und Analytics-Lösungen, einschließlich KI-/ML-Plattformen, Analytics-Stacks sowie moderner Engineering-Praktiken. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects, Data Analysts, Data Engineers und IT-Teams entwickelst du Referenzarchitekturen und Richtlinien, sorgst für eine konsistente Analytics-Landschaft und übersetzt Geschäftsanforderungen sowie komplexe technische Konzepte in klare, praxisorientierte Lösungsdesigns in Abstimmung mit den relevanten Stakeholdern.

PLATTFORM- & SERVICEVERANTWORTUNG

Du übernimmst die Rolle des Platform- und Service Owners für zugewiesene KI- und Analytics-Anwendungen, definierst deren strategische Weiterentwicklung und verantwortest das operative Management. Darüber hinaus entwickelst du Governance-Frameworks und Best Practices, um eine effektive Nutzung der Plattformen unter Berücksichtigung regulatorischer Anforderungen, Datenschutzrichtlinien und Standards sicherzustellen.

IT-PROJEKT- & LIEFERANTENMANAGEMENT

Du leitest und unterstützt IT-Projekte und Programme gemäß etablierten Projektmanagement-Methoden und stellst durch ein effizientes Management von Budgets, Zeitplänen und Ressourcen eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicher. Zusätzlich unterstützt du Verhandlungen und pflegst nachhaltige Beziehungen zu externen Dienstleistern und Partnern.

IT-BERATUNG

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du als Fachexperte bei der Analyse und Behebung von Problemen in den Bereichen KI und Data Engineering, optimierst die Performance von Anwendungen und stellst die Einhaltung von Anforderungen an Datensicherheit und Datenschutz sicher. Durch die kontinuierliche Auseinandersetzung mit aktuellen und zukünftigen Trends in den Bereichen KI, Analytics und Software Engineering förderst du Best Practices und treibst die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung voran.

EXPERTISE

Hier zählt Erfahrung und bisher erbrachte Leistungen

Für die Rolle relevant

• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Engineering oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung mit starkem Fokus auf Künstliche Intelligenz, Data Analytics, Large Language Models (LLMs) und Software Engineering

• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen IT, Software oder Data Engineering

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit modernen Data-Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery oder vergleichbare Lösungen) sowie mit führenden Cloud-Plattformen (Azure, AWS oder GCP)

• Fundierte Erfahrung im Design skalierbarer Datenarchitekturen

• Tiefgehende Kenntnisse in Data Warehousing, Datenmodellierung und ELT-/ETL-Tools (z. B. dbt, Dagster, Fivetran)

• Nachweisbare Erfolge im Management von IT-Projekten und -Programmen

• Praktische Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Implementierung von LLM-basierten Lösungen (z. B. RAG-Architekturen, Vektordatenbanken, agentenbasierte Workflows)

• Travel: 0-10 %

JETZT BEWERBEN

Lust auf eine Herausforderung?

Wir freuen uns auf eine Bewerbung, die Motivation und Kompetenzen enthält - und vor allem auch die Persönlichkeit dahinter erkennen lässt.

Bewerben

Aus gesetzlichen Gründen sind wir verpflichtet darauf hinzuweisen, dass das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt für diese Position monatlich bei EUR 2.535 brutto liegt. Unsere attraktiven Gehaltspakete orientieren sich jedoch an aktuellen Marktgehältern und liegen daher deutlich über dem angegebenen Mindestgehalt. Als Arbeitgeber schätzen wir Diversität und unterstützen Menschen ihre Potenziale und Stärken zu entfalten, ihre Ideen zu verwirklichen und Chancen zu ergreifen. Passioniert glauben wir daran, dass Diversität unter Kollegen ein zentrales Element unseres Erfolgs ist. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aller Menschen gleichermaßen, unabhängig von Alter, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung oder Herkunft.

Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten

• Entwicklung neuer Wachstumsfelder und strategischer Kund:innenenbeziehungen im Cyber- / AI-Umfeld (z.B. AI Governance, Digital Trust)

Fähigkeiten für deinen Erfolg

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Cyber Security, AI oder Digital Transformation

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau neuer Markt- oder Serviceangebote

• Erfahrung in Teamführung / Business Development

• Tiefes Verständnis aktueller AI- und Cyber-Themen

• Starke Kundenorientierung und Executive Presence

• Mobilität: Übernahme der Kosten für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sowie zusätzliche Angebote wie Bike-Leasing erleichtern deinen Weg ins Office.

• Gelebte Feedbackkultur: Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, klare Entwicklungsziele und transparente Leistungsbeurteilung begleiten deinen Karriereweg bei EY.

Das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt liegt bei EUR 3.820,52 . Das tatsächliche Gehalt hängt von deiner Berufserfahrung und Qualifikation ab und wird mit einem All-in-Gehalt vergütet.

title: AI and Digitalization Operations Manager (m/f/d)
description_snippet: Your responsibilities: Identify and structure AI use cases in manufacturing operations based on business impact and feasibility. Lead AI pilot projects from scoping to implementation, including KPI definition, ROI tracking...
description_full:
AI and Digitalization Operations Manager (m/f/d)

With around 9,000 employees, AGRANA is the global leader in fruit preparations and also a major producer of fruit juice concentrates in Europe as well as being a key manufacturer of customised starch products and organic ethanol in its Starch segment. AGRANA is also one of today's leading sugar companies in Central and Eastern Europe.

We are seeking a dedicated AI and Digitalization Operations Manager (m/f/d) to join our team as soon as possible on a full-time basis.

In this role, you will drive the industrialization of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across AGRANA's operations. You will identify, prioritize, and implement high-value AI use cases and ensure successful solutions are scaled across production sites, delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, energy consumption, reliability, and safety.

Your responsibilities:

• Identify and structure AI use cases in manufacturing operations based on business impact and feasibility.

• Lead AI pilot projects from scoping to implementation, including KPI definition, ROI tracking and operational relevance.

• Drive the transition from pilot to scalable solutions across multiple production sites.

• Act as the interface between Operations and the AI Center of Excellence, translating business needs into technical requirements.

• Collaborate closely with plant managers, engineers, operational teams, and AI technology experts to ensure adoption and integration into daily operations.

• Promote AI awareness and support change management and capability-building initiatives across Operations.

• Monitor and drive measurable improvements in operational efficiency, cost, energy consumption, product quality, and operational reliability.

Your profile

• Master's degree in Engineering, Process Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

• Additional training in AI, advanced analytics, or digital technologies is an advantage.

• 7-12 years of experience in manufacturing, process industry, operational excellence, or a comparable environment.

• Proven experience in digitalization, data analytics, or AI-driven initiatives.

• Strong understanding of industrial processes, including production, maintenance, quality, and energy management.

• Experience leading cross-functional projects involving Operations and IT/OT.

• Experience scaling solutions across multiple sites is a strong advantage.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across all organizational levels.

• Fluency in English is required; German is preferred.

Our offer

• Excellent occupational and personal development perspectives within an international group with headquarters in Austria

• A unique opportunity to shape the future of AI in manufacturing and drive tangible business impact.

• Diversified and interesting tasks in a dynamic team

• Various internal company benefits e.g. working from home, staff canteen, various sport and leisure-time activities, health care offers etc.

• Our attractive remuneration is based on current market salaries. You can expect an annual gross salary starting at EUR 80,000,- all in, whereby we are open to overpayment in the case of corresponding qualifications and experience.

Contact
 Marlene EBNER | HR Business Partner

Find out more about AGRANA Group and also visit us on LinkedIn.

As a global company, we are very proud of our diverse workforce and attach great importance to equal opportunity and diversity. We welcome and encourage everyone regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, religion or sexual orientation who is passionate about our company to apply.

Have we caught your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your application.

title: (Senior) Sales Analyst*in
description_full:
karriere.at ist Österreichs größtes Jobportal und besteht aus rund 200 motivierten Mitarbeiter*innen, die sich täglich dafür einsetzen, Talente und Unternehmen erfolgreich zusammenzubringen.

(Senior) Sales Analyst*in

Deine Aufgaben bei karriere.at

• Du steuerst unsere Sales Performance durch KPI-basierte Reportings, Forecasts und datengetriebene Handlungsempfehlungen zur Erreichung unserer Vertriebsziele.

• Du verwandelst komplexe Daten in aussagekräftige Insights und unterstützt Management und Vertrieb mit Dashboards, Analysen und Entscheidungsvorlagen.

• Du identifizierst Wachstums-, Upsell- und Cross-Sell-Potenziale, analysierst Markt- und Vertriebstrends und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab.

• Du entwickelst unsere Sales Analytics kontinuierlich weiter, integrierst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen, optimierst Datenmodelle und setzt moderne Analyse- und KI-Tools ein.

• Du bist strategischer Sparring Partnerin für Vertrieb und Management und unterstützt Business Reviews, Jahresplanung sowie bereichsübergreifende Entscheidungen mit fundierten Datenanalysen.

Unsere Anforderungen

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Data Analytics, Business Intelligence oder Sales Analytics sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL und Excel.

• Erfahrung mit BI- und Visualisierungstools (z. B. Tableau, Power BI) sowie ein gutes Verständnis moderner Datenarchitekturen und Datenmodelle.

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten verständlich aufzubereiten und unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf Management- und Fachebene souverän zu beraten.

• Analytische, strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Affinität zu datengetriebenen Entscheidungen und KI-gestützten Analysewerkzeugen (z. B. Microsoft Copilot).

• Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Cloud Data Platforms (z. B. BigQuery, Azure, GCP) und Predictive Analytics.

title: CRM & Retention Specialist (f/m/d)
description_full:
As our CRM & Retention Specialist (f/m/d), you will shape the strategic, technological, and operational development of our customer communication.

 You will ensure that our customers receive personalized and relevant experiences across every stage of the customer lifecycle. Your focus will be on marketing automation, scalable CRM processes, seamless system integrations, and increasing Customer Lifetime Value through data-driven insights and outstanding content.

 At the heart of this role is one guiding principle:
 "CRM is not a support function - it is the engine behind customer lifetime value and brand loyalty."

CRM & Retention Specialist (f/m/d)

"CRM is not a support function - it is the engine behind customer lifetime value and brand loyalty."

Your areas of responsibility

Strategic Responsibility

• Take full ownership of our CRM ecosystem, including email, SMS, WhatsApp, direct mail, inserts, and our Premium Club.

• Develop and implement a long-term CRM and lifecycle marketing strategy focused on automation, customer loyalty, retention, and Customer Lifetime Value.

• Manage CRM performance based on relevant KPIs such as Customer Lifetime Value, email and automation flow revenue, retention rate, NPS, and contribution margin.

• Position CRM as a strategic business partner and growth driver across the company.

• Continuously develop our loyalty program to increase customer retention, Customer Lifetime Value, and profitability.

• Translate customer data and business objectives into actionable CRM initiatives.

Lifecycle & Automation

• Design, optimize, and scale automated customer lifecycle journeys across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, loyalty, and reactivation.

• Expand AI-supported personalization, dynamic content, predictive segmentation, and automated CRM campaigns.

• Identify and implement automation opportunities, such as automated loyalty tiering through Shopify and ESP integrations.

• Continuously improve CRM workflows and processes to increase scalability, efficiency, and campaign quality.

• Establish structured testing and optimization processes, including A/B testing and performance analysis.

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and develop the CRM team both professionally and personally.

• Guide the team through transformation, growth, and the development of specialized roles such as CRM Specialist or Marketing Automation Manager.

• Define an effective team setup that supports our long-term CRM vision and business objectives.

• Foster a collaborative learning culture with a strong focus on technical expertise, data-driven decision-making, and a digital mindset.

• Set clear priorities, responsibilities, and performance expectations for the team.

Systems, Interfaces & Projects

• Ensure the seamless integration of our CRM technology stack, including our ESP, Shopify, loyalty platform, WhatsApp, and other customer-facing systems.

• Work closely with Performance Marketing, IT, Content, Product, Customer Support, and other relevant departments.

• Lead cross-functional projects related to customer journeys, CRM processes, data, and marketing technology.

• Contribute to company-wide roadmap and strategy discussions and actively shape the development of our customer experience.

• Ensure that CRM processes, responsibilities, and system workflows are clearly documented and scalable.

Your profile

• 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, email marketing, or marketing automation - ideally within D2C e-commerce.

• Initial leadership experience and the ability to guide a team through change, transformation, and growth.

• Strong hands-on experience with an email service provider or customer engagement platform such as Netcore, Klaviyo, Emarsys, or a comparable solution.

• In-depth understanding of marketing automation, customer segmentation, lifecycle journeys, personalization, and campaign optimization.

• Experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform, as well as CRM integrations and data flows.

• Proven experience in optimizing processes and scaling CRM or lifecycle marketing activities.

• An analytical mindset and strong Excel and data analysis skills for KPI evaluation, forecasting, and business cases.

• Strong commercial understanding and the confidence to manage the full CRM value chain - from open and click rates to revenue, Customer Lifetime Value, and contribution margin.

• A hands-on and structured working style, combined with the ability to improve and document processes.

• Excellent German and very good English skills; French is an advantage.

Hart Facts

• Start: as soon as possible

• Hours per week: 38,5 hours

• Workplace: Holzkern HQ in Vienna

Salary

The collective agreement minimum salary is 2.535 EUR gross per month (on a 38,5-hour basis). The actual salary depends on your qualifications and experience and is between 50.000 EUR und 56.000 EUR gross per year (on a 38,5-hour basis). The salary is paid 14 times per year. The collective agreement Handel mit Mode und Freizeitartikeln (Textilhandel) applies.

HOLZKERN was founded in 2016 with the purpose of creating unique pieces of nature - just as unique as our customers. Seven years later, we are one of the most successful D2C brands in DACH selling a huge variety of watches, jewelry & accessories. We're proud to say that over 1.000.000 customers worldwide were already able to find their perfect piece of nature. Join our team of over 170 people and help us to bring natural uniqueness to the whole world!

 As a dynamic team, we value open corporate communication, teamwork, development opportunities and flexible working hours. But most of all, you can expect to work in a friendly working environment with warm-hearted colleagues who will always support you.
